# Hi Peter, there are only a few days left of 2024! As a valued member of OLCV, I wanted to give you a sneak peak of what’s ahead of us in 2025.
---
[**Peter, we’ve got a lot of work to do in 2025 to protect our climate and environment. Will you help by making a contribution to OLCV today? We can’t do it without you.** ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99476669/520025235/-2029533079?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUyZDQyMzAxLTQxYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TMlGEiLhzE3OdnUAU12Dvfg-pLZLx-PSBmrBfmMcmCs=&emci=b9f71446-7dbe-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&emdi=52d42301-41c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=2107230) First, I have to address the elephant in the room. There is undoubtedly a lot of work ahead of us given the results from the federal election. One of the major tasks we know we will face next year is defending our state from climate threats and attempts to backslide on our progress on climate - all things we can’t afford. On top of this, with pro-environment supermajorities in both the Oregon House and Senate, we have a responsibility and a mandate to continue making progress on climate. Here’s an inside look into our priorities for 2025:
* Passing a transportation package that centers climate and equity;
* Advancing solutions for more affordable clean energy, including funding popular climate programs and protecting Oregonians from sky-high rate hikes by holding utility companies accountable;
* Protecting our streamflows and responsibly managing Oregon’s water to ensure a legacy of healthy rivers for everyone and everything that depends on our water.

---
The 2025 legislative session is not far away, so we’re gearing up and equipping our team with everything they need to fight to secure these wins for our climate - stay tuned for more details! There’s so much we can achieve together, but we need your support to get there. [**Will you consider making an end-of-year gift to OLCV today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99476672/520025271/-2029533079?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUyZDQyMzAxLTQxYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TMlGEiLhzE3OdnUAU12Dvfg-pLZLx-PSBmrBfmMcmCs=&emci=b9f71446-7dbe-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&emdi=52d42301-41c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=2107230) We’re in a _critical_ time for our state and climate - we all know this - and [**it doesn’t take much to have a large impact in this fight.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99476678/520025276/-2029533079?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUyZDQyMzAxLTQxYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TMlGEiLhzE3OdnUAU12Dvfg-pLZLx-PSBmrBfmMcmCs=&emci=b9f71446-7dbe-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&emdi=52d42301-41c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=2107230)

**THE YOUNG DEMOCRATS OF AMERICA REMEMBER JIMMY CARTER: A CHAMPION OF PEACE, PROGRESS, AND HUMANITY**
---
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **December 29, 2024**
**Contact: Kait Ahern — communications@yda.org**
---
WASHINGTON, DC — At the 1976 Democratic National Convention, President Carter made a promise to our nation that “the people run the government, not the other way around.” With unshakable integrity, he carried that promise through every stage in his life.

Today, Young Democrats across the nation join in mourning the loss of President Jimmy Carter—a proud son of Georgia, a Governor, a Naval Lieutenant, a peanut farmer, and a champion of civil rights. As President, he established the Department of Education, federally protected over 100 million acres of land and water, and brokered historic peace deals (including SALT II, the Camp David Accords, and the Panama Canal treaties).

President Carter's humility was perhaps his most remarkable trait. He treated every person he encountered— whether a world leader or a volunteer on a Habitat for Humanity build site— with the same respect, kindness, and dignity. He reminded us that the true measure of a person is not in the power they wield but in how they treat others once they've gained it. Today, it can be easy for us to feel disheartened by the future we face as a nation. Yet as President Carter once reminded us in his Inaugural Address: “We must adjust to changing times and still hold to unchanging principles.”

Now more than ever, we must uphold the unchanging principles of compassion, equality, and faith in humanity that guided Jimmy Carter throughout his life. Let them inspire us as we fight to expand voting rights, civil rights, access to healthcare, environmental protections, and reproductive rights. They remind us that, no matter how difficult the journey, progress is always worth pursuing.
---
###
---

---

name: Steve Kerrigan
subject: Honoring President Jimmy Carter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee Massachusetts Democratic Party
body:
| | |
---
| | Dear Massachusetts Democrats, Today, we honor the life and service of former President Jimmy Carter. President Carter was a true servant leader whose impact on the world and the lives he touched can never be fully measured. During his long and purpose-driven life, President Carter was guided by his faith, love of country, and sense of responsibility to his community. From his formative years as a Naval Officer to his humanitarian work later in life, President Carter was always in service of others. In the days to come, many memories will be shared about President Carter, and I hope that we can use them as an opportunity to remind ourselves of the difference one person can make.
---
---
President Carter was an optimist, and that is a gift he leaves each of us. I am grateful our Party can count President Carter as one of our own and for the leadership he provided our country, during his time as President, and for the many years after. May President Carter rest in eternal peace and may the thought of his reunion with First Lady Rosalynn Carter bring his family and all who loved him comfort at this time of loss. With gratitude for a life well lived in service of others,
---
| |
---
| | Steve KerriganChair, Massachusetts Democratic Party

Look at this view, Peter. Even as you sit here in front of a computer screen this stunning place is out there:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99477921/520053463/-1700217077?contactdata=ayy+Qm3ttamjoZ3EbhkCGBTqke70MLa20w3Y1Q3RscRZ1VNM/akqI/laz2QN8tG2DXPSsBy0OIgEEh+oDr0pb5m2wecIPwTpqoFSv6ijnaf3NL3OpgFcIrfUU+JrF1/o4Wzy2Dp8b47u1lgNgPFguiE2i2pSt/e6HLjkgyFN6uY=&ms=YE24_EM14_Img1&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYWM3Y2Q1LTQ4YzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZSuBoeRqV7oxa0cq44HkLd9VOXf7mf90zOqrjFu5uuc=&emci=3cb464fe-a7bc-ef11-88d0-000d3a9d5840&emdi=6bac7cd5-48c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=1504551)
Sonoma Coast Redwoods follows the meandering coastline: with salty air carried on winds into the forest, fog rolling in over the canopy, raptors circling golden grasslands and rocky bluffs, and the Pacific stretching out into forever.
What if only a few people with private estates had the opportunity to gaze out over all of this beauty?
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99477922/520053467/-1700217077?contactdata=ayy+Qm3ttamjoZ3EbhkCGBTqke70MLa20w3Y1Q3RscRZ1VNM/akqI/laz2QN8tG2DXPSsBy0OIgEEh+oDr0pb5m2wecIPwTpqoFSv6ijnaf3NL3OpgFcIrfUU+JrF1/o4Wzy2Dp8b47u1lgNgPFguiE2i2pSt/e6HLjkgyFN6uY=&ms=YE24_EM14_Img2&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYWM3Y2Q1LTQ4YzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZSuBoeRqV7oxa0cq44HkLd9VOXf7mf90zOqrjFu5uuc=&emci=3cb464fe-a7bc-ef11-88d0-000d3a9d5840&emdi=6bac7cd5-48c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=1504551)
[**Give to protect Sonoma Coast Redwoods for everyone!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99477923/520053469/-1700217077?contactdata=ayy+Qm3ttamjoZ3EbhkCGBTqke70MLa20w3Y1Q3RscRZ1VNM/akqI/laz2QN8tG2DXPSsBy0OIgEEh+oDr0pb5m2wecIPwTpqoFSv6ijnaf3NL3OpgFcIrfUU+JrF1/o4Wzy2Dp8b47u1lgNgPFguiE2i2pSt/e6HLjkgyFN6uY=&ms=YE24_EM14_Link1&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYWM3Y2Q1LTQ4YzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZSuBoeRqV7oxa0cq44HkLd9VOXf7mf90zOqrjFu5uuc=&emci=3cb464fe-a7bc-ef11-88d0-000d3a9d5840&emdi=6bac7cd5-48c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=1504551)
Developers have long had their eyes on Sonoma Coast Redwoods – understandably! – this stretch of breathtaking coastline is exceptional.
But we believe redwood landscapes like this should be protected so the trees can grow into old-growth, so the rich wildlife ecosystem can flourish, and so forest lovers like you can visit and experience the marvels of the forest for generations to come.
[**Help us seize this incredible opportunity to forever protect an iconic California landscape.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99477924/520053473/-1700217077?contactdata=ayy+Qm3ttamjoZ3EbhkCGBTqke70MLa20w3Y1Q3RscRZ1VNM/akqI/laz2QN8tG2DXPSsBy0OIgEEh+oDr0pb5m2wecIPwTpqoFSv6ijnaf3NL3OpgFcIrfUU+JrF1/o4Wzy2Dp8b47u1lgNgPFguiE2i2pSt/e6HLjkgyFN6uY=&ms=YE24_EM14_Link2&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYWM3Y2Q1LTQ4YzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZSuBoeRqV7oxa0cq44HkLd9VOXf7mf90zOqrjFu5uuc=&emci=3cb464fe-a7bc-ef11-88d0-000d3a9d5840&emdi=6bac7cd5-48c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=1504551)
Lying within 50 miles of a population of 2 million, this landscape offers an incredible opportunity to invite locals and visitors alike to experience the wonders of where the redwoods meet the coastline.
Situated in Sonoma County, these 1,600+ acres of beauty have the potential to provide the missing link in the California Coastal Trail extension, an entry point into the natural wonder of the redwood forests that shouldn’t be reserved for a few wealthy landowners.
[**To help us finalize the purchase, the Schuman Family Foundation and the Troper Wojcicki Foundation are matching all gifts now through year-end to triple your impact.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99477925/520053476/-1700217077?contactdata=ayy+Qm3ttamjoZ3EbhkCGBTqke70MLa20w3Y1Q3RscRZ1VNM/akqI/laz2QN8tG2DXPSsBy0OIgEEh+oDr0pb5m2wecIPwTpqoFSv6ijnaf3NL3OpgFcIrfUU+JrF1/o4Wzy2Dp8b47u1lgNgPFguiE2i2pSt/e6HLjkgyFN6uY=&ms=YE24_EM14_Link3&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYWM3Y2Q1LTQ4YzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZSuBoeRqV7oxa0cq44HkLd9VOXf7mf90zOqrjFu5uuc=&emci=3cb464fe-a7bc-ef11-88d0-000d3a9d5840&emdi=6bac7cd5-48c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=1504551) [**Give by Dec. 31!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99477926/520053480/-1700217077?contactdata=ayy+Qm3ttamjoZ3EbhkCGBTqke70MLa20w3Y1Q3RscRZ1VNM/akqI/laz2QN8tG2DXPSsBy0OIgEEh+oDr0pb5m2wecIPwTpqoFSv6ijnaf3NL3OpgFcIrfUU+JrF1/o4Wzy2Dp8b47u1lgNgPFguiE2i2pSt/e6HLjkgyFN6uY=&ms=YE24_EM14_Link4&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZiYWM3Y2Q1LTQ4YzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZSuBoeRqV7oxa0cq44HkLd9VOXf7mf90zOqrjFu5uuc=&emci=3cb464fe-a7bc-ef11-88d0-000d3a9d5840&emdi=6bac7cd5-48c6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=1504551)

clean_body: 🔗The missing link? Look at this view, Peter. Even as you sit here in front of a computer screen this stunning place is out there: Sonoma Coast Redwoods follows the meandering coastline: with salty air carried on winds into the forest, fog rolling in over the canopy, raptors circling golden grasslands and rocky bluffs, and the Pacific stretching out into forever. What if only a few people with private estates had the opportunity to gaze out over all of this beauty? Developers have long had their eyes on Sonoma Coast Redwoods – understandably! – this stretch of breathtaking coastline is exceptional. But we believe redwood landscapes like this should be protected so the trees can grow into old-growth, so the rich wildlife ecosystem can flourish, and so forest lovers like you can visit and experience the marvels of the forest for generations to come. Lying within 50 miles of a population of 2 million, this landscape offers an incredible opportunity to invite locals and visitors alike to experience the wonders of where the redwoods meet the coastline. Situated in Sonoma County, these 1,600+ acres of beauty have the potential to provide the missing link in the California Coastal Trail extension, an entry point into the natural wonder of the redwood forests that shouldn’t be reserved for a few wealthy landowners. Thank you for helping to safeguard Sonoma Coast Redwoods. | Adrianna Andreucci Land Protection Manager ---|--- Photos by Justin Lewis, Coldwater Collective | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States tel:415-362-2352 | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- |

Georgia Democrats join our state, nation, and the world in mourning the loss of former President Jimmy Carter. President Carter leaves one of the greatest legacies of humanitarianism in history. Throughout his long life of service, he never paused in his relentless pursuit of a more peaceful, healthy, and just world.

My husband Leslie and I named our son Carter after our 39th president because he showed us that ordinary Georgians can do extraordinary things. He was one of the greatest public servants of our time — and he was also a peanut farmer from Plains, Georgia. From a southwest Georgia town of a few hundred people to the Oval Office, President Carter went from sowing crops to sowing the seeds of peace around the world.

President Carter’s leadership has long been, and will continue to be, a north star for Georgia Democrats. We will strive to carry forward his legacy of service and compassion while we work, as he did, to reshape his beloved home state for the better. We are holding the Carter family and all those who loved President Carter in our hearts.

Sincerely,
Chair Nikema Williams
Chair, Democratic Party of Georgia

We can end the Electoral College forever and live in the democracy we deserve. Chip in $25 or whatever you can today to help us fight for the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact and more >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=122924_3&amount=25]

Straight from the mouth of NBC's Chuck Todd, folks:
“Is anyone really happy with this bizarre Electoral College system we use today to decide our president?”
The answer is no. It’s the biggest tool the opponents of voting rights have to swing national elections and suppress the will of the people. We have to take away this dangerous mechanism that enabled the January 6th insurrection before it happens again. And there is a way to do it!

clean_body: Chuck Todd is right -- nobody is happy with the current Electoral College system and our country deserves better . The American people deserve a system where their votes directly count and their voices aren't muffled. We can end the Electoral College forever and live in the democracy we deserve. Chip in $25 or whatever you can today to help us fight for the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact and more >> [] Voter Action Project Logo [] Straight from the mouth of NBC's Chuck Todd, folks: “Is anyone really happy with this bizarre Electoral College system we use today to decide our president?” The answer is no. It’s the biggest tool the opponents of voting rights have to swing national elections and suppress the will of the people. We have to take away this dangerous mechanism that enabled the January 6th insurrection before it happens again. And there is a way to do it! The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 16 states plus DC have already joined, accounting for 206 electoral votes of the 270 needed to win. Vote suppressors have proven there’s no length they won’t go to in order to win. A look ahead to 2025 for Rocky Mountain Voice
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**December 29, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
As we close out 2024, I’m very grateful for all we’ve accomplished together through Rocky Mountain Voice. This year, we’ve built more than just a media outlet—we’ve built a movement. A movement rooted in truth, liberty, and the values that make Colorado exceptional.

With your support we’ve established a fast-growing and respected news source to combat the liberal bias of Colorado media. We’re not just another platform—we’re the TRUTH, a trusted hub for the Colorado freedom movement. Under the guidance of our Editor, Brian Porter, a seasoned news man, and former Colorado Press Association President, we’ve developed a stellar news team. Supported by over 30 citizen journalists and a robust social media presence, RMV has become a daily touchpoint for over 150,000 Colorado voters through our Mountain Minute newsletter.

Our website aggregates news from trusted conservative outlets like the Gazette, Colorado Politics, Independence Institute, and Common Sense Institute, while steadily increasing our original content. **Our mission is clear:** build trust through truth, always remain pro-citizen, pro-liberty, and pro-Colorado, and honor the heritage of rugged individualism that defines our state.

This year, RMV became a key player in Colorado politics, driving the narrative, defending conservative principles, and building voter trust—something sorely missing in Colorado. Our Rocky Mountain Voice Ambassador outreach team has worked tirelessly to make the freedom movement FUN again here, hosting rallies, information sessions, and appearing at fairs and festivals across the state. We’re not just growing a digital community; we’re fostering community across the state.

**What’s Next in 2025?**
Looking ahead, 2025 will be a transformative year for RMV. We’re launching _regional hubs_ across the state, each with a dedicated reporter and community ambassador to bring the grassroots together. This local approach will make our content more relevant and specific to readers while strengthening the freedom movement in every corner of Colorado.

Our goals are bold but achievable. We aim to double our Mountain Minute subscriber base, continue to establish RMV as THE trusted news source in Colorado, and reach over a million website visitors. RMVTV will provide video content, shows, and podcasts, ensuring we continue to build our online community. \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: A.G. Holder
Date: Thurs, Dec 26, 2024
Subject: It's not the time for acceptance and resignation

Next month, Donald Trump and a radical Republican-led federal government will take office.
For much of his first presidency, Trump’s incompetence tended to mitigate somewhat the impact of his malevolence. But he still managed to seriously damage our democracy because many of the checks in our Constitution simply didn’t work. The Supreme Court, his attorneys general, the Senate and the House signed off on key pillars of a dangerous, anti-democracy agenda and always failed to hold him accountable.
**Given this, one thing is abundantly clear headed into Trump’s second term: The only check left on his power is us. It’s the power of the people: a power that is too often underestimated and too infrequently used.**
**This is not a time for acceptance and resignation — this is the time for commitment and action.**
[**So today I am personally asking you to donate to the NDRC before the end of the year to help us to do the hard, and absolutely necessary work of defending our democracy — help protect fair maps, combat ongoing gerrymandering, and prepare for the redistricting battles coming our way.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99478982/520067491/1701676424?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGEOYLiftnote_email_20241229-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYLiftnote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241229-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYLiftnote_&utm_campaign=AGEOYLiftnote&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNhNjQzOGM0LTUxYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z5ciUqs1wtYzYZLaOmwOuXHtqtqKX2eHnCZmbdBQ23s=)
The Trump Republican Party just isn’t that into democracy — because their priority isn’t respecting the will of the people; it’s accruing the power to implement their agenda that caters to the special interests and perpetuates their illegitimate political control.
Want a recent example? Last month in North Carolina, in a lame duck legislative session and over the governor’s veto, Republicans added anti-democracy provisions (in a disaster relief bill!) that will take power away from the Democratic governor and give it to the newly elected Republican auditor. They are also attempting to restrict the ability of the incoming Democratic Attorney General to legally oppose any measures they might pass. It’s clear that Republicans care more about political control than getting needed relief to hurricane victims in the state. It’s also clear that they are willing to break our democracy to keep power they illegitimately hold.
**In the long run, the history of American democracy has always been one of grinding, halting, uneven success — even in the face of tyranny. So it must be again.**
Here’s the thing, though: We have to work for it. The path to progress has never been blazed through inertia. The NDRC has a strong 10 Year Plan. We know these efforts are paying off, and we know how to execute — we just need to make sure we have the financial resources to fund this work.
[**No matter how it feels today, it remains true: A better future is in reach, as long as we’re willing to fight for it. Are you with me? If so, please consider making a contribution.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99478983/520067492/1701676424?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGEOYLiftnote_email_20241229-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYLiftnote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241229-NDRC-Tier1-AGEOYLiftnote_&utm_campaign=AGEOYLiftnote&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNhNjQzOGM0LTUxYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z5ciUqs1wtYzYZLaOmwOuXHtqtqKX2eHnCZmbdBQ23s=)
Thanks again,
Eric H. Holder, Jr.
82nd Attorney General of the United States

Holder Date: Thurs, Dec 26, 2024 Subject: It's not the time for acceptance and resignation Next month, Donald Trump and a radical Republican-led federal government will take office. For much of his first presidency, Trump’s incompetence tended to mitigate somewhat the impact of his malevolence. But he still managed to seriously damage our democracy because many of the checks in our Constitution simply didn’t work. The Supreme Court, his attorneys general, the Senate and the House signed off on key pillars of a dangerous, anti-democracy agenda and always failed to hold him accountable. Given this, one thing is abundantly clear headed into Trump’s second term: The only check left on his power is us. It’s the power of the people: a power that is too often underestimated and too infrequently used. This is not a time for acceptance and resignation — this is the time for commitment and action. = The Trump Republican Party just isn’t that into democracy — because their priority isn’t respecting the will of the people; it’s accruing the power to implement their agenda that caters to the special interests and perpetuates their illegitimate political control. Want a recent example? Last month in North Carolina, in a lame duck legislative session and over the governor’s veto, Republicans added anti-democracy provisions (in a disaster relief bill!) that will take power away from the Democratic governor and give it to the newly elected Republican auditor. They are also attempting to restrict the ability of the incoming Democratic Attorney General to legally oppose any measures they might pass. It’s clear that Republicans care more about political control than getting needed relief to hurricane victims in the state. It’s also clear that they are willing to break our democracy to keep power they illegitimately hold. In the long run, the history of American democracy has always been one of grinding, halting, uneven success — even in the face of tyranny. So it must be again. Here’s the thing, though: We have to work for it. The path to progress has never been blazed through inertia. The NDRC has a strong 10 Year Plan. name: Don Huffines
subject: Goodbye Vehicle "Safety" Inspections!
body:
At the Huffines Liberty Foundation, we are excited about 2025—and you should be, too. This is going to be a tremendous Legislative Session in Texas.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-sdjhiky-yuddtktydi-w/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sdjhiky-yuddtktydi-r/) **Goodbye Vehicle "Safety" Inspections!** [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sdjhiky-yuddtktydi-y/) On January 1, 2025, Texans will finally be free from the burdensome and unnecessary vehicle "safety" inspection--a program that has cost Texas drivers billions of dollars and billions of hours of their time. This victory has been a long time coming, and I am honored to have fought alongside you to eliminate this practice both during my time in the Texas Senate and through the efforts of the Huffines Liberty Foundation.In 2017, when I was in the Texas Senate, eliminating the vehicle inspection program was among my top legislative priorities. While my bill passed the Senate, it was killed in the House in the final week of the session.In 2023, the Huffines Liberty Foundation, in collaboration with allies in the Senate and House, reignited the effort, and I'm thrilled to announce that the bill has finally become law.Make no mistake: this was NEVER about safety. It was about protecting the profits of special interest groups--new car dealers, small repair shops, and big government lovers--who fought tooth and nail to keep the chains of government on Texans. Vehicle "safety" inspections were nothing more than another property tax masquerading as a public good, draining Texans of both money and time.The data is clear. Insurance companies, with access to the most comprehensive crash data available, confirm what studies have repeatedly shown: there is no difference in crash rates, injuries, or fatalities between states that require vehicle inspections and those that don't. Yet Texas is the ONLY Republican-led state to still mandate vehicle "safety" inspections. Texas will join 35 other states in ending this practice.This is a BIG WIN for Texans, but the march for liberty continues. Unfortunately, emissions inspections remain mandatory in major metropolitan areas of Texas. Like the safety inspection program, emissions inspections are a complete rip-off--hopefully, the legislature will eliminate it this session like several other states have.The fundamental role of government is to protect your liberty, including your freedom to travel, without unnecessary and intrusive government interference. Texans deserve nothing less.This victory is proof that perseverance pays off, and I'm proud to stand with the countless Texans who fought for their right to keep their hard-earned money and reclaim their time._[Click here to share this message.](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sdjhiky-yuddtktydi-j/)_ **Happy New Year!** [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sdjhiky-yuddtktydi-t/) Time is something that we don't control. It's always moving forward--whether you want it to or not.How you experience time is up to you. Every second that you are alive is another opportunity for you to satisfy the goals you created in your life.What is the purpose of life? What is it I want to accomplish? What is the legacy I want to leave?At the Huffines Liberty Foundation, we are excited about 2025--and you should be, too. This is going to be a tremendous Legislative Session in Texas.HLF is coming out with new whitepapers that will help you hold your legislators accountable. So be sure to check out HuffinesLiberty.com and read the solutions! [WATCH: New Year message from Don Huffines](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sdjhiky-yuddtktydi-i/) May God bless you, your family, and the great state of Texas. Our greatest days are coming. See you on the battlefield, and Happy New Year!!For Liberty, Prosperity, and Virtue Always, Don Huffines
_Father, papa, businessman, and former TX Senator_ P.S. Thank you for your service to our nation and to our world, Jimmy Carter. May flights of angels sing thee to thy rest.
By the time Kamala Harris became the Democratic candidate, Carter was already in hospice care. Nonetheless, he got to cast a vote for Harris. I'm sad he did not get to see her take the oath of office as President.
I received the news of Carter's death as I was making campaign fundraising calls in my bid for the Special election in NY-21 (as of yet unannounced by NY Gov Kathy Hochul).
Carter's first campaign raised $13.8 million, including $3.5 million in federal matching funds. An AI generator puts that $13.8 million in 1976 dollars at something like $65.8 million in 2024 dollars, adjusted for inflation. Either way, that sounds like an enormous sum of money.
But wait. Between Biden and Harris, some $2.5 billion was raised.
And they still did not win.
For the Harris campaign, people in rural areas were told they needed to buy their own yard signs; the campaign did not have enough time or money to get signs delivered to them.
In NY-21 fundraising, the Democratic candidate who ran in 2022 raised $2.1 million over approximately 18 months. He earned 116,421 votes.
In 2024, I raised less than $200,000 over six months. I earned 132,447 votes.
As a candidate, I learned that money makes a difference in a campaign, but it is not necessarily the deciding factor in the number of votes.
Indeed, the platform and the issue of candidate fundraising are no longer the deciding factors in our political environment.
Without ever being on a ballot, Elon Musk elevated himself to what is arguably the single most powerful position in the world by contributing $277 million to Donald Trump's campaign. In so doing, Musk became the single largest donor to a political campaign in history.
Literally without running for office, Musk won what some are calling a co-presidency, or a chance at being named Speaker of the House of Representatives.
Where does it stop?
Well - it probably won't stop in time for the Special Election in NY-21 that is anticipated in 2025.
But I keep the faith.
I have a loyal base of donors who generously contribute to my campaign on a monthly basis. Their numbers grow each day. I could hug each and every one of them. Their belief in my campaign inspires me on my days of doubt.
As I call around and start to send out fundraising texts, I hit on a few people who are eager to support me in a possible Special Election run. This is heartfelt, and much appreciated.
But I have also hit on a few people who say, "Nope! Not giving to Democrats. I gave lots of money to Democrats and I'm not doing it again until they get their act together. Good luck to you, but I'm sitting this one out."
Fair.
I get it. Maybe I'll do like the Girl Scouts and start selling cookies.
Whatever it takes. I am compelled to fight the good fight for the middle class. I'm running on kitchen tables, like closing the income gap, solving the housing crisis, and Medicare for All.
Tonight I am longing for simpler days and honest leaders like we saw in the 1976 Jimmy Carter campaign.
I continue in this race because I truly believe we can turn this around.
I continue in this race because I truly believe we _**must**_ turn this around.
Maybe I won't bake cookies, but I have volunteers who make yard signs.
Not quite two years ago, in an OpEd in the [NY Times on January 5, 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/a0fbd05b-0a3e-43c2-ba82-9cb2d1cbcb7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Jimmy Carter said:
> _"Our great nation now teeters on the brink of a widening abyss. Without immediate action, we are at genuine risk of civil conflict and losing our precious democracy. Americans must set aside differences and work together before it is too late."_
In the same Op-Ed, Carter also said, "For American democracy to endure, we must demand that our leaders and candidates uphold the ideals of freedom and adhere to high standards of conduct."
As we honor our beloved 39th President, please help me or help some other candidate continue to fight the fight so we can build - as he did, one house at a time - a brighter future generations to come, based on honesty, integrity, and an eternal quest for justice and equality.
_I 'm the Democratic Candidate who ran in NY-21 in November 2024. I am seeking the nomination for the Special Election ballot. You can learn more about me at [www.paulacollinsforcongress.com.](https://substack.com/redirect/681451be-ca29-4f56-9418-d124cfa80b18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _

body:
Friend,

As 2024 comes to a close, we have a lot to be grateful for this year. President Trump will be President of the United States again, and we regained the Senate majority!

_**[But now we must look to 2025.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)** We will still be focused on supporting Senate Republicans as they fight with President Trump to Make America Great Again. _

We can't lose this majority we worked so hard to build after just two years. **[Otherwise, President Trump would be a"lame duck" president, and we would waste years of opportunities because our leaders would not have the political muscle they need.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)**

In 2024, many of our candidates entered their races facing 2, 3, 4, or even 5 to 1 financial deficits they were never able to close. **[Unfortunately, Friend, this cost Republicans multiple winnable seats in the U.S. Senate.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)**

**[Friend, would you please consider making a generous year-end contribution to support our Incumbent Republican candidates and GOP nominees fighting to secure critical seats we need to HOLD our Senate majority?](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)**

******************************************************[CONTRIBUTE BEFORE DECEMBER 31st>>](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)******************************************************

We want our Republican incumbents and candidates to start on a solid financial footing in these can't-lose races. The Democrats have corrupt billionaires on their side and the lamestream media marketing their ideas free of charge.

We know money can be tight around the Christmas season, but we must help our candidates build war chests now so they are not stuck trying to fill a financial gap when they should be focused on winning.

**[Even if it's just $5, your support for Senate Republicans will help protect our new majority and strengthen Republicans' standing in Congress.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)**

Last month, we were outraised by Senate Democrats - we cannot let this happen again.

We want to finish December _and 2024_ on top. **[Please chip in whatever you can before the end of the year!](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)**

Thank you,
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)
Steve Daines
Chairman, National Republican Senatorial Committee

P.S. Please don't let Senate Democrats beat us again. **[Before the clock strikes midnight on New Year's Eve, please send whatever you can to protect our Senate majority!](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WcmeA61SSzrjqsniKCw8nQ~~/AAVLBgA~)**

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Intel
subject: You think this is the end of an era?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWhhwaSWgN
I'm reaching out with a bold prediction-what do you think about
this...
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWhhwaSWgN

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Friend, how are you today? I'm reaching out with a bold
prediction-what do you think about this...

Big media
is over.

It's the
end of an era. And I can't say I'm sad to see it go.

But the
death spiral of the legacy news media means that I need YOUR
urgent help to be forward-thinking during this news revolution.

I'll tell
you more about how you can help in just a moment, but first, let
me tell you why we need to act right away.

Next
year, there's one thing we can absolutely expect…

Big media
will continue to call for censorship of new media. And honestly,
is that any surprise to you?

The
ladies on The View are already blaming the election results on X
(formerly Twitter) and "misinformation." The New York Times
claims we're experiencing a "dark turn in democracy." Rachel
Maddow cried on MSNBC about the dangers of Elon Musk and new
media. Here's the thing-so-called "Big Media" has been corrupt
and one-sided for a long, long time. In fact...

Hillsdale
has led the fight against "Big media" for decades-with YOUR help!

Imprimis-an important alternative to pervasive and pernicious
far-Left narratives-first reached the mailboxes of a few thousand
readers in 1972. Now, we fight against dangerous ideologies
through our free online courses, Hillsdale College Podcast
Network, and all our outreach on social media.

And our
outreach numbers in the millions-a far cry from the few thousand
folks that received the first issue of Imprimis back in '72!

We've
also partnered for decades with talk-radio shows and podcast
hosts like Mark Levin, Tucker Carlson, and Charlie Kirk. We've
also had the blessing to work with some of the best radio hosts
in history-Rush Limbaugh and Paul Harvey-to promote the
principles of liberty that Hillsdale staunchly defends.

This has
been some of our most important work. And it's work we couldn't
do without YOU. You've especially been a big help to us during
attacks from legacy media and censorship from Big Tech companies
like Facebook.

Thank you
so much!

Next
year-as Big Media clings desperately to remain relevant-we can
expect more attacks, so I pray you'll continue to stand with us
for TRUTH against Leftist dogmas.

An
important part of our Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty
through Education will be confronting Big Media head-on. As more
Americans begin turning off MSNBC and canceling their New York
Times subscriptions, with your generous gift today, you will
provide…

Free
subscriptions to Imprimis-our digest of liberty-featuring
constitutional perspectives on contemporary problems, including
immigration, the weaponization of government, and education.

Podcasts including "The Larry Arnn Show," "Hillsdale Dialogues,"
and "Liberty and Learning with Mark Levin," all on our Hillsdale
College Podcast Network, part of the "New Media" that more and
more people-especially and including young people-are tuning in
to.
Free
online courses on the Constitution, American history,
Christianity, and Marxism-especially important as our audience
for these courses begins to become younger and younger. We've got
a great lineup of courses planned for 2025, by the way...

Massive outreach on social media-including X (formerly known as
Twitter)-where we often share our educational content, such as
lectures from Hillsdale events, free online courses, informative
surveys, and our learning videos.

I hope
you know we can only accomplish all of this with your help.

Are you
with us?

This is
an exciting time when we can do so much to restore liberty.
Together, we will STOP Big Media LIES and propaganda and TEACH
the American people the TRUTH about the principles underlying our
Constitution.

To do so,
we must expand these programs further than we ever have
before-and that brings me to my last point...

I'm
asking for your most generous year-end support for next year's
Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education.

If you
haven't renewed your support yet, can I count on you to please
give your best tax-deductible year-end gift right away?

You can
make your gift online, safely and securely, at this link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/64146202:WhhwaSWgN:m:3:2532013465:558BAD6208299005ABBB4E5D3B4DFB46:r

And
because we can count on the support of informed patriots like
you, we'll continue to accomplish our goals without taking ONE
PENNY of government funding-even indirectly in the form of
student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY-to remain INDEPENDENT.

So please
help us reach our $6,000,000 year-end online goal by December 31
(that's only a few days away!).

Your gift
of any size will help us restore liberty today, and secure
liberty for the long term. After all, there is only one way to
save liberty in America-EDUCATION.

Thank you
for helping us meet this historic moment head-on-and for reading
all the way to the end of this email! Really appreciate you,

Bill
Gray, '01
Vice
President

Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale
College

P.S. The
era of Big Media is over. But next year, as legacy media attempts
to cling to relevance, we can expect even more attacks. So I need
your help to provide all our outreach, including Imprimis, the
Hillsdale College Podcast Network, and free online courses, to
millions for FREE. Next year, we plan to expand our outreach to
newer and younger audiences.

Thanks to
the help of informed patriots like you, we remain on the vanguard
of new media-standing up to the lies and propaganda of the legacy
media with the TRUTH about the principles underlying our
Constitution. This work will be even more important in 2025.

That's
why I hope I can count on you today for a generous,
tax-deductible gift to help us meet our $6,000,000 online funding
goal-before December 31. I've included your secure link to give
right now here:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/64146202:WhhwaSWgN:m:3:2532013465:558BAD6208299005ABBB4E5D3B4DFB46:r

## Jimmy Carter Dies at 100
Jimmy Carter, the 39th U.S. President, [died yesterday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvwyAUBOBfAxsRPGwIA0MXb-na0SLmObwITIRRIv_7yt073-nT6X5u8y1Qpu3xHQr6vtYZJAxCgdByjoHyMQ88-hURUHP0yupxHK0Dx5PXCu0djbNBr3iHaO4OgjVBq3CN1l05-VNToKVSIMfxMliM7mwGuSyjs2yQGKnXdnlW2nrCNR_1je2y1MKzT72_dqa_GEwMpp4wUc5nxmBKteCGn53BpK_GmEGJtbaCTbwa7hRx6-JJpRxiCa1jE5FwF6ELJSWDiTcfXx_KmXZzzniUQH807__d8PbwGwAA__8cXV6y) in Plains, Georgia, as the oldest former president in U.S. history. A peanut farmer from Georgia, Carter rose through the political ranks quickly to become governor and then president, defeating Gerald Ford in 1976. His presidency from 1977 to 1981 saw achievements like the Camp David Accords but was overshadowed by economic challenges and the Iran hostage crisis. Carter [revamped his image](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGuqzAMQL8mbKDEIU0zZHgLW996RxSwKa4CQZAW8fdX6X63M9jHR_559I_Akdfn_7CQz1PqQUJbK6i17DFwvPq2Qj8RAemKvLLaGGMduGr2450Ga_Uw2dGhJhiQnDLSuhvq6T5hxb7YFGipFEhjmtYSugHwFuQ4GmdFKwk5p715JV7zTFO80of2ZkxLFf2c83YI_U9AJ6A7z7N5HyEnDFcZENAdOe2XgG6l8xDQbSly5rFgOSygU1DYCehevCxXPYY9014jE9ba5bnedjoYac11Gji_w1enlG5BGSVlWa92j9vJMfJxK8XPJXD8Fua_Pvbx8BsAAP__RaVrgw) post-presidency, becoming a champion for humanitarian causes and receiving the Nobel Peace Prize in 2002. Carter began receiving hospice care in February 2023 and celebrated his 100th birthday this past October. [View his life in photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OtCAUxvGr0Q4DR1EpKN7Gbt52S4NyHM-EDwPskLn7jdtv_SRPfvl_PdaHIUfh-d941OWIK3AYmADW89Uacp91aK0-EAH7FrWYeinlpEC1pzYHn5UxYpt2PgultlECzHyQsKlJwNCSvt8E9FwI4FJ2w4RWbWBHw_ddqqkZOFoqMXWvSKGceLhPfGPq9uhbp89Srtz0_xpYGlhqrV3Y9oA133sDS3ZkMZ-xNrBcaMJ3YYdJHhO7EmayGAp7kfcftptUMLHMHB3IrjOWmFkQfOb9OLZJ26uSc5THm_T0htwvofyV5K3hJwAA__-wemPP).
## South Korea Jet Crash Kills 179
A Jeju Air Boeing 737-800 [crashed and burst into flames](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ8GOiJ7jQ0uXPxNuvztlWhhd4PvHIyML1He_sT1V45Gmvn0fdymG8YUt_t_fHCokidQ0HcaOqMmwpjeU99SEGZg03LQg7HWDh58uwYeZ56RhUi8H5Vz3uBiDIkWhzJIG8O5psEorUFZe-kHJj8DOVTLYv3Q9Iop1lwunzludWVJ7_zkclnyo01hrXU_GvOvgWsDV9w3fh1ndYZS45K4geuRv-vafeXC2O0JN-4kFu7cSOhnNZPV3gkzOR4IaB57L73T2JZA-yumFA93ctwfGNPvb_3LwzPATwAAAP__T7hfiA) at an airport in South Korea on Sunday, killing 179 of the 181 people on board in one of the country's deadliest aviation disasters. The plane, arriving from Bangkok, apparently failed to deploy its landing gear and skidded off the runway at high speed before slamming into a concrete wall and exploding, [according to television footage](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzGPhCAUBOBfA92axwN0KSiusdtrrzQIz5UNilEi2fv1F6_fbpJJvsn8PIaHiymuz2-3kC1THhBQ3QTeJAzBxfQeFA92IkKSnKzopNa6M2j4bB3QCGBQtE4ZLVEDursxRk1SBe87Hu2lCZQgBILWjeoomBFD68B7bTqmgEIseW9eOa5lpim980l74_PCk51L2Q4mvxj2DPtaazOO_uoY9ivVg2F_xkD5Cv4Xdkwvvd0p892GrcaU4tFeG8_FxfRvlk8fT4t_AQAA__8cSlIT). Approximately 1,570 firefighters, police officers, soldiers, and other rescue workers were dispatched to the scene following the crash. Officials recovered the flight data and cockpit voice recorders while investigating whether [bird strikes may have contributed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAUBp8Gd0RwbOxQUNyGLrfd0uLn2CZLwAISy2-_8vbbfdInjUbz9ZgfJsSQ1v_mhaoteQYGA-VAezZ7E-I5D51XCyJg36HiUy-EmCTIblMo5eIlTDgye-eOs-luezu6Ea3g1oouqIvGoWecAxPiNkzopQU_GuackBMZGPrQcrk9c0htwyWe-YPl5vKri2prba-k_0dAE9Dp3HNt10VAX2ACmsO1JQF95BI9TXhUAvqJzzc1odDd1IppxVLpZt6phbTSJSQT6ZGLr7TS71zQUFdM3Qjorii_HyHGUMfLbn2ZEH9t2l91Pgp-AgAA__-0JWaJ) to the crash. The crash occurred shortly after the control tower warned the crew about birds and permitted them to land at a different location.

Severe weather, including deadly tornadoes, disrupted holiday travel over the weekend, [delaying thousands of flights](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPhCAUhH8Ndhh8wKIFxTV2e-2VhvM9Fy4oG8A1_vuLm1x5zRQzyeTL93Wf7i7EsD0-3Uq2LmkCAYp3wKWY0IV4TqpBuxAByYZsZ6TW2gwwNN5KCdosRoG4KdJSzaZfTC_6vh9ASJibYK-3DqToOhBat8oQDt-ANyfmWQ-GKUEYasrtTwpb9bTEM70ot3Nam2h9rc_C5AeDkcF4HEebaa-Uy7VfTcoRGYx7YTBWn_biNix8ieHha-FI0Z2E3M05lcL3wtNGHMnhO-LJa8qbw8RLTXkt3IfKfYoB3cn_PMDAYGyyxecRYgzldkE_VhfiG7L-J-1l4TcAAP__XaVuqw). ## Federal Court Blocks Biden from Selling Wall
A federal court in Texas has ordered the Biden Administration to [halt the sale of unused border wall materials](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OwyAQBp8GdxvBYmxcUFzjLtdeaa3DOuGEjQXk7-1PTn_dSqtvNJqf83SmEMN2_aaVXX0taUKJLSgELSdPIb6ntvFuln5QDTvVa2OM1b1ubq4zLfp-Vrrzijt9keQJDS9DZ81iZd8Ed8AUaqkU2ladWFrDpK1WPQ2DJdFK9qGmfKo3rvyissR3enA-XdLaRHerdS9CfwkcBY7be0-lHi-B40EWOCo8bitwvBfY-FkEjgt7zhTh9-6vDCl7zgXm4HkD8mvYQqmZakgb1ASlph0KxyMCfBRg_kzgSTHCTrkezCY7vz9DjKF0vWjldaUQP5b132wPh38BAAD__0KBb_Q) following allegations that panels were being auctioned off for as little as $5. Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, who filed a motion earlier this month to block the sale of unused materials, hailed the decision as a victory for border security and the rule of law. In May, a court ordered the Department of Homeland Security to [spend $1.4 billion allocated by Congress](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFywjAQBNCvsbvz6CQbyYWKNHSkTek5W2e4RFiMrCD4-wz06XffzuzXaTqRRNnOn3RlXx5rmrTSPaAGo6ZAEp9T3wY_qzBiyx6tGYbBGWvai59HXtk6Qj2yWi0feB3GgIT9vDjL3Ip_YaiNQtSux46VG5iMM2hpHB01veIgJeWuXLjwg_Y1PtOdc7ekaxv9pZTb3piPRh8bfay1dhvXvTL_vAKNPr47sC8p8w5zyoEzVIoR7rKUlJ_wwuA7McwSeIMl_y5CEapsoJWyCrHNPtyqxCj7wTa9Ol9J4nu__HvI3eu_AAAA__9pRmSq) for the construction of a southern border wall. Friday’s ruling requires the administration to verify it has not violated that order. Earlier this month, President-elect Donald Trump [characterized the effort](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPhCAQhX8NdhoYVKCguIZur73SjDK7S4JikF3Xf3_h-msmXzHv5cv7uU03DDFsj29cyZbPPU3AoW8FtJJPHkO8pr7xdubeiIasUHIYBi2VbJ52me9jL_QMkjQaPxiOWsNs9Nh7AxKaYGuZAMmFAN2LjrgeCKWWQqExGlnPyYeScleeVOiDxz1e6U25W9LaRPssZT-Y_GLgGLjzPLvXgSV5vOoDA3eUlC8GbqPzYOD2FEMJS0WKtJSQtsrVgoETUM_IwJX8Wvd2Dp62dk7ZU25PjLHdMZcaUIrDaAznXDFwTbZ-P0OM4RgV6_ljxRD_DMu_k70t_AYAAP__7F5rEg) to sell unused border wall materials as an “almost criminal act.” The remarks followed Texas Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick’s pledge to purchase the materials and give them to the incoming Trump Administration if the auctions continued.
## Black Bear Sightings on the Rise
Black bear sightings are [becoming increasingly common](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQhX8NbKDz2Q5m8NAlW7p2RId9BKsGI-OG5N9XRF27fXpP-p70vm7DjUIM6_2TFrblOaUBAVUjsJEweArxNaja2xF8L2q2opNaayM7Wc_WkzYGtUNwblQjdF544VyPyqCbBNTBnjKBEoRAo0TLYDSTNFJ01PeGKgXsQ0m5LTMXftI-xVd6cG5dWupo51K2vZIfFV4rvB7H0bo5p_VsK7zGMPEZh-j_kHIJLp70ljVjJPfdjEy54dWln7Vw3hsEADSXvt3mrc7Wb0eIMeyXrlJwXyjE93r5946Hxd8AAAD__1HvYdk) across Texas as the species recolonizes the state. By the 1950s, black bears had been relegated to Mexico due to overhunting and habitat loss. Hikers regularly spot black bears at Big Bend National Park. Last year, they were seen in Uvalde and even in Orange, east of Beaumont. Earlier this month, an Alpine neighborhood was placed [under a "bear watch"](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO8yAQhJ8GOix2wb-hoPibdLn2SmtjNgGJxBZGIXn7k6Nrr_s0I30jzfd5PlMu-XH7ojuH9rquM2q0ClAZPUfK5T1bGcNFRw-SA0xmHEdnJiNT8EzWRMKFgRwgRmPJIVqOhgiYZQ6HDNBoAHQWBtZuZDLOwETeOxJWc8xtrUNL3PhF-7W81yfXYVnvsoTU2rYL81_gSeCp9z4sqa6PoxV4KvnKR5xL_EWqLS_loAtTVZ3aklTnvamPXIH3o0Vww5Y2WUPcei4l7_8mYfXtTrl8dtufRzwD_gQAAP__N1pf1w) after officials received reports of a black bear near homes. Residents can avoid unwanted interactions with bears by securing pet food and outdoor grills and installing bear-proof dumpsters. Loud noise usually scares bears away if they are encountered. "_We're working to get Texans in general to realize bears are a real thing, and they do exist here_ ,” [said Matthew Hewitt](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFvhCAUwPFPA5sXeIDCwNDF7bp2NHg8lAR9Rul5fvum17n7P7_k_3Uf7iGXvE6fYUFfX4kGEKAbCY0SQwy5XIPm0Y8iOsnRy04ZY6zqFJ89jjY4jdaNwrqUrACTgtXKtNEITC3P_heToISUYLW8obAGg7JKdsE5G5gWGHOl_VZnrPgKRyoXPXG_PWjhxc-1bgdTHwx6Bv07eBBtG51_CYOevvdmpeNqVjybFfM0j7QfDHq--7iduZR8tB3TYlpCLm-3_jv69PATAAD__-BEVgk), a wildlife research assistant at Sul Ross State University.

Texas Tech, Texas A&M, and TCU played in bowl games over the weekend, but only one got a win. On Friday, The Arkansas Razorbacks defeated the Texas Tech Red Raiders 39-26 in the Liberty Bowl in Memphis. Yesterday, Arkansas tackle Fernando Carmona apologized for [intentionally stepping on a Texas Tech player’s ankle](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPozAQBeBfYzpHnjEcULi4xl2uvRIN9hC8MRjZVjb8-xXpt3vSkz49vf_36U4hhv3xjzY29b2kCRW2ElBqNXkK8ZzaxptZ-REaNtDrrusG3etmNR4BibUDNzuEHgdw3AMunWppHmFugrkwQK0AcGjhxmromPSgoadxHEi0in2oKd_qypXfVJZ4phfnm0tbE81a61GE_ivQCrT7eaRSr0qgvWSBFvDKo0BbjpRrEWg_jqzs1iLdl5ypPDm_QowscziKpPykvVCRC-eddp-ko7ylneSSsvQh11OSqwJtk40_vkOMofzpRaseG4X4mVZ__epl8CcAAP__rhNr-A). Also on Friday, the Texas A&M Aggies [fell to the USC Trojans 35-31](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL_uozAQhJ_GdIv8BwdTuLiGLtdeiRa8gKMlzmEnhLc_cf2vnBnp0-j7cx_uGDk-l9-4kS_fOQ1a6gaUBiOHgJHPoamCH2XoVEVetcZa60xrqtWTswotGtfOGG4UjNVhcrcwUxdcZ20V_QVT2kiltGtUTdJZQuOMarHrHIpGUogl7XVZqdAX88xn-tBeT2mr2K-lvLIwv4Tuhe6P46hzvCah-ykx00JC9wW3t9D9nFIZkflqLhIgbIDLEinDyOkAA3lKO0GmKT0DrMgzMGGAkuCdJyh7euAzX5FTJmDM8KEFM4zpYJDqsdjz-_d026PafXgdkTnmWysauWwY-f_n8qPEj9f_AgAA__8-tnag) in the Las Vegas Bowl, blowing a 17-point third-quarter lead. | | | | folks, Yesterday, we lost a true American hero, Jimmy Carter—a leader whose life exemplified integrity, resilience, and a relentless pursuit of justice. As the 39th president, he stood for values that transcended politics, championing human rights, advancing diplomacy, and working to build bridges in a divided world. His dedication to peace earned him a Nobel Prize, but it was his actions—his unwavering commitment to fairness and equality—that truly defined his legacy on the global stage. When Carter took office in 1977, the nation was grappling with the aftermath of Watergate, an energy crisis, and deep public mistrust. He tackled these challenges with determination and a moral clarity that prioritized human rights and diplomacy above all else. While his independent style sometimes clashed with Washington’s culture, his focus on doing what was right over what was popular defined his time in office. His presidency left lasting legacy of peace, standing firmly against unnecessary wars and resisting pressures from powerful groups like the Israeli lobby. In a nation with a history of near-constant conflict—having only been at peace for 16 years since its founding—Carter’s presidency accounted for four of those years, a testament to his dedication to diplomacy over violence. Despite criticism and attempts to diminish his legacy, his refusal to bow to war-driven agendas highlighted his courage and deep humanity. What made Jimmy Carter extraordinary wasn’t just his presidency but his life after leaving the Oval Office. He didn’t simply retire—he redefined what public service means. From building homes with Habitat for Humanity to eradicating diseases through the Carter Center, he spent his post-presidency transforming lives, embodying the very best of humanity. President Carter’s legacy will not fade. His life’s work will continue to inspire countless people to strive for a world that is fairer, more just, and more compassionate. He leaves behind an example for us all—a life lived in the relentless pursuit of what is right and a belief that even one person can make a profound difference.

subject: Who was the real Captain Morgan?
body:
The Captain Morgan rum brand is named after a real person: the legendary Welsh privateer and buccaneer Captain Henry Morgan, who terrorized Spanish ships in the 17th century. # [Captain Morgan was a real person.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spb2tt&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spb2tt&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spb2tt&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T he Captain Morgan rum brand is named after a real person: the legendary Welsh privateer and buccaneer [Captain Henry Morgan](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spb2tt&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), who terrorized Spanish ships in the 17th century. Morgan was born in Wales around 1635, but his famous swashbuckling adventures took place in the Caribbean, where he was sent to fight the Spanish. Privateers were kind of legal pirates: They worked as representatives of a government, raiding rival nations on their sponsoring nation’s behalf, while keeping some of the fortune for themselves. Morgan was part of a group known as the “Brethren of the Coast” — real-life pirates of the Caribbean — and his exploits gained him both wealth and lasting fame.
---
Captain Morgan led many raids against Spanish colonies, most famously in 1671, when he took 1,000 men and captured Panama City. While his previous raids had been during wartime, the Panama City attack came after a peace treaty was signed between England and Spain, meaning Morgan was acting illegally as a pirate. He was returned to England to stand trial, but the English people, who had heard of his exploits, treated him more like a hero than a criminal, and he was even knighted by King Charles II. When he returned to Jamaica, he left the pirate world behind and became lieutenant-governor of the colony; upon his death at age 53, he was given a state funeral in Port Royal with ships firing guns in salute. Centuries later, in 1944, when the Seagram company set up a rum distillery in Jamaica, they named it after the larger-than-life local buccaneer.

## There’s another rum named after a British sea captain.
Most people have heard of Captain Morgan rum, but if you’d like to save a few dollars, you could try Admiral Nelson instead. The brand is named for another British sailor, Vice Admiral Horatio Nelson, who is considered one of the greatest naval leaders in Britain’s history. (Writer Lord Byron even [called him](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=spb2tt&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) “Britannia’s God of War.”) When Nelson died at the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar during the Napoleonic Wars, his body was preserved in a cask of spirits, and “Nelson’s blood” became a nickname for both brandy and rum. So it’s not surprising that when the Heaven Hill Distillery developed a rum brand, they named it after Admiral Nelson. Unlike the image on the bottle, however, the real Nelson had sandy gray hair, no eye patch, and only one arm after losing his right arm in battle.

subject: I tried to do everything in my power to avoid this…

body:
Brace yourself because 2025 will be a WHOLE new ballgame!

| |
---
| | | I tried to do everything in my power to avoid this...

This is the last message I wanted to send you today but our backs are up against the wall. We're about to fall 10-15% SHORT of our final fundraising goal of the year!

**[So if you're able, I'm humbly asking you to contribute ten or twenty bucks before our final deadline of 2024.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zgth038rgr0l4nur5shiuap4l2k07dh8sor7hlh0_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge8or2chh2bs "So if you’re able, I’m humbly asking you to contribute ten or twenty bucks before our final deadline of 2024.") After that, our numbers go public - and the Radical Democrats are chomping at the bit for any sign of weakness so they can swoop in and DESTROY our House Majority.**

To put it plainly, if we come up even 1% short of our goal, they'll claim House Republicans are doomed, twist the narrative, and try to kneecap our Majority before we even get off the ground.

If we don't catch up now, I'm afraid it'll only get worse... _So if you thought 2024 was bad when they tried to:_

- Imprison President Trump
- Censor Conservative voices
- Weaponize the government against Americans
- Allow non-citizens to vote in our elections
- Pack the Supreme Court

**... Brace yourself because 2025 will be a whole new ballgame!**

This fight won't be easy - it never is. House Democrats have already plotted their plan to take back the Speaker's gavel AND we're going toe-to-toe with Liberal dark money groups that have ALREADY mobilized to flip key battleground districts.

**_[But what you do right now can have a direct and immediate impact on the future of our country- just a few bucks make a world of a difference.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z183tjv59ggc0f9oa4m22i32nlq1saqvbqd28th8_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge8or2chh2bs "But what you do right now can have a direct and immediate impact on the future of our country – just a few bucks makes a world of a difference.")_ **And if you don't have anything to spare right now, know you are still a valued member of this team.

I couldn't be more grateful or more honored to fight alongside you.

Thank you for everything you do.

For America,

Steve Scalise

---

name: Hillsdale College via American Defense News
subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a National Referendum on Religious Liberty.

This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbtjmvi0eqa3bb289jcc4io4s6vdvugst96gv320_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge8or2chh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zf6fu7kcqk4jmdef6ggurf5ch90j87tslhjorkbo_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge8or2chh2bs) The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://info.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2rdrq1dp2tahau6knaht9hbccqiaeujicmp2o6o_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge8or2chh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://info.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zaf9e2btufqf6htq88ct0nb2vo9voq5pou4j6qog_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge8or2chh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.
