subject: Happy Hanukkah! Let's talk about Jews
body:
Let's take a look at Jews in America and how Americans think about us.

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.LzRYbbUklATEAF08NUEJbv9mypaPWkx_c4uaiUM_O_A?) for more
---
# [Happy Hanukkah! Let's talk about Jews](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=153545398&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUzNTQ1Mzk4LCJpYXQiOjE3MzU1NjQ0NzksImV4cCI6MTczODE1NjQ3OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.W1GwmJm13iVEpzyztWn-tozeE4cl3tW8gjeuDoZV3yU)
### Taking a look at Jews in America and how Americans think about us.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
| Dec 30
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvYmVuc2FtdWVscy9wL2hhcHB5LWhhbnVra2FoLWxldHMtdGFsay1hYm91dC1qZXdzLWpld2lzaC1nZW9ncmFwaHk_.FRTv0l0H7vDlqkXBHpfA3FZrVL6oW2CFjaIUqfAJZMI?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/bensamuels/p/happy-hanukkah-lets-talk-about-jews-jewish-geography?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

I'm Jewish. That's not a surprise to the people who know me,1 and it's [something I talked about publicly](https://substack.com/redirect/e17ecf78-a996-4062-b09f-38350e0a256c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when I ran for Congress.2
In large part because of what's happening in the Middle East, Jewish issues were more top of mind during the 2024 presidential election than in the past.3 But that's been analyzed every which way already, and it's not what I'll focus on here.
Instead, I'll talk about where Jews live, and how the 100+ million Americans who don't know someone Jewish think about these issues--**Americans like Carter, who I interviewed for this newsletter. He 's an Army Reserve veteran, and until we met, he hadn't ever met a Jewish person before.**
Going into our conversation, my sense had been that Jews are either loved or loathed in the U.S.:
* Jewish people are the [most favorably viewed religious group in the U.S.](https://substack.com/redirect/dbc62a53-e3c0-4d0b-9ff7-84cc52128475?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Simultaneously, and paradoxically, Jews are also [widely distrusted](https://substack.com/redirect/dc35073c-e4fd-481c-98bc-e17cee7dab1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and are, by far, the [target of the most religious hate crimes](https://substack.com/redirect/19b8538e-61b1-4b79-88ea-4528374e4ab0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of any group in America.

But the truth is more nuanced: there are lots of people who don't think about these issues at all, because they're not relevant in their communities.4
As we do more cultural exchange across religious and cultural groups within America--work I believe is vital--it's important to keep that in mind.
[Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/726a2109-fd86-4846-b1a9-f527bab243e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### [Jewish Geography](https://substack.com/redirect/6a46b44b-fa90-4d2c-b183-dec808feca6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
According to recent Pew survey data, [2.4% of U.S. adults are Jewish](https://substack.com/redirect/bed086e8-18d2-4fe6-abbc-6ca1361d0ccb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).5 But that doesn't tell you much about where Jews live, because the population is incredibly concentrated.
There are [3,143 counties in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/3afe979b-9194-40a7-94a6-2effd5a6342d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and Jews are heavily concentrated in just a handful of them: [96% of American Jews live in urban or suburban areas](https://substack.com/redirect/af1ee3d1-a109-48df-bb6d-3ccd8b764862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).6
What that means is that there are large swaths of the country [where there are few or no Jews](https://substack.com/redirect/8bec400e-28f7-4bb9-ad6d-91b2174a13bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):7
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/503beae6-1a8e-4c76-b6d5-7b300bb9fac5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Using county-level data to estimate whether someone knows a Jew is a _highly_ inexact science, but it does line up--very, very roughly--with surveys that suggests that **[34% of American adults don't know someone who is Jewish](https://substack.com/redirect/9fb06462-9402-4d0d-b636-55c8db94621f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.8
Why does all of this matter?
* For starters, people who know someone who's Jewish are [far less likely to hold antisemitic views](https://substack.com/redirect/9fb06462-9402-4d0d-b636-55c8db94621f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).9
* Personally, it's a blind spot: by definition, I don't know anyone who doesn't know a Jew, and that's 100+ million Americans.10

All of that informed my conversation with Carter.11
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=153545398&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUzNTQ1Mzk4LCJpYXQiOjE3MzU1NjQ0NzksImV4cCI6MTczODE1NjQ3OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.W1GwmJm13iVEpzyztWn-tozeE4cl3tW8gjeuDoZV3yU)
### How I got to know Carter
For the last bunch of years, I've been involved in a mentorship program called [ACP](https://substack.com/redirect/a9b1e80f-868e-4446-b044-59cb9d759669?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which helps people leaving the military with resume review, interview prep, etc.
At the beginning of the year, I was paired with Carter, who's in his mid-20s and who grew up in rural Oklahoma.12 He served in the Army National Guard for six years and graduated from college in the [Texas panhandle](https://substack.com/redirect/78c3e81d-79f6-4e29-9335-af76ab1591b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He and his family recently moved away, but for a few years they'd been living about an hour outside of [Lubbock, Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4266f6-1a66-455d-af16-ded584092ee6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).13
When I floated whether he'd be interested in chatting with me about this, I asked if he'd ever met a Jewish person before.
As far as he knew, he had not.
### How communities like Carter's think about Jews
The answer, maybe unsurprisingly, is not much.
I assumed that if I asked him to name a famous Jewish person, he would've come up with someone: maybe someone like [Adam Sandler](https://substack.com/redirect/70a37e5e-4573-4976-a7cf-bcf2cdc3be2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who has widespread appeal, or [Ben Shapiro](https://substack.com/redirect/8353f2b2-06ec-49ba-965c-da267ba689d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who's reasonably well known--especially in conservative circles.14
But no, when I asked, the answer was probably more predictable: Jesus Christ. That was a lot of the framing of Jewishness for Carter and others in his community.
[Listen now * 0:57](https://substack.com/redirect/4411cbcf-7770-4bb3-b88b-2c2995d055b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
What about in school--did Jewish culture ever come up? Again, the answer is no, not really. More on the Holocaust in a moment, but growing up in Oklahoma, to the extent that education had any focus on minority groups, that was centered around the Native American community.
[Listen now * 1:05](https://substack.com/redirect/4411cbcf-7770-4bb3-b88b-2c2995d055b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
### Antisemitism, racism, and discrimination
I asked Carter whether he knew what antisemitism was. He didn't. But when I gave him some examples of what anti-Jewishness might look like, he couldn't remember anything like what I offered.15
That became a broader discussion of discrimination in the U.S. today, and here's what he had to say:
[Listen now * 1:14](https://substack.com/redirect/4411cbcf-7770-4bb3-b88b-2c2995d055b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
Carter mentioned two things to back up his assertion that white people face discrimination in the U.S. today:
* The sense that anything that white people do is perceived as racist.
* Affirmative action. (For context: [68% of adults say that race shouldn't be a consideration in college admissions](https://substack.com/redirect/d23a6f4a-5080-46cd-b047-2082f20eda06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).16)

Without taking a position on either issue, he's hardly alone here.17 White Americans, and especially white Republicans, say that [anti-white racism is increasingly a problem for them](https://substack.com/redirect/8a9747e0-efe0-4636-b6d1-dcbdf80a53cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### Holocaust education
There is [much more to understanding Jews and Judaism than learning about the Holocaust](https://substack.com/redirect/096e3321-287f-4bbe-9fac-7e678fac6538?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but it's still important. Across the U.S., [23 states mandate Holocaust education](https://substack.com/redirect/01799140-2718-4696-8300-33fad985908f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).18
So it was disheartening when Carter didn't immediately know what the Holocaust was. That's not an indictment against him; it's really an indictment of our educational system. And it's jarring to me, for whom the Holocaust is not just personal but also informs [a lot of the way that I see the world](https://substack.com/redirect/446e0671-7397-4d56-bc4a-679744920957?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
When reminded, he did remember, basically, the ["never again"](https://substack.com/redirect/5df47d22-5698-4d0d-b0e5-b6722e9228e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) mantra associated with the atrocities of the Holocaust.
[Listen now * 0:53](https://substack.com/redirect/4411cbcf-7770-4bb3-b88b-2c2995d055b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
The challenge, of course, is that for "never again" to mean something, we'd have to know first and foremost what we're not repeating.
He's not alone in this, of course; [many younger people are unfamiliar with the Holocaust or the particulars of it](https://substack.com/redirect/5e46d201-1b6f-418e-be02-faa3fd3d096b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and that's a huge problem we have to grapple with.19
[Listen now * 1:16](https://substack.com/redirect/4411cbcf-7770-4bb3-b88b-2c2995d055b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
### Let's not conflate unfamiliarity with bigotry or dislike
For people who live a state or two away from each other, Carter and I live remarkably different lives. I'm fortunate to know Carter, and I'd encourage anyone who has the opportunity to talk to people way outside of their social circles to do so.
**It is important that we educate people on different cultures. In this specific context, when so many Americans don 't know much about Jews, and [when antisemitism is on the rise](https://substack.com/redirect/aae99926-5572-4a02-b482-9ab6d7b4c1a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), that's especially important.**
At the same time, someone not knowing about antisemitism is not the same thing as being prejudiced.
As ever, in a country as divided as ours, **it 's a reminder that people who don't use what we deem to be the right language, phraseology, or frames of reference are probably still good people.** That doesn't absolve of us of the responsibility to do more in terms of education and cultural exchange, but it's important to acknowledge nonetheless.
[Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/726a2109-fd86-4846-b1a9-f527bab243e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In the new year, I'll talk more about how the media covers Jews (and issues related to other minorities), what they get right, and where the narrative is wrong. More to come.
_**Feel free to share this post with someone who will find this interesting.** (If you're reading this email because someone sent it to you, [please consider subscribing](https://substack.com/redirect/726a2109-fd86-4846-b1a9-f527bab243e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)_
_I do not receive direct replies to this email. For press inquiries, please contact press@ben-samuels.com._
1
My ability to quote _Seinfeld_ and the entire anthology of Mel Brooks is notable, if entirely useless.
2
Confusingly, there is a different writer named [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/redirect/4f87c38c-a53c-4d85-bd89-d743a05f57d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who covers Jewish issues in the U.S. He's a great reporter but I am not him.
3
[Antisemitism in the U.S. is very real](https://substack.com/redirect/dc35073c-e4fd-481c-98bc-e17cee7dab1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and it's also deployed as a political weapon by people who don't really care to address it. Throughout the election, people accused [Donald Trump of being an antisemite](https://substack.com/redirect/f3852394-d55e-4694-b7eb-b97ba4f1382e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and accused [Kamala Harris of being an antisemite](https://substack.com/redirect/24d437d6-f667-4046-bdc9-6a459a5db731?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (I've written about [how antisemitism came into play in St. Louis politics](https://substack.com/redirect/aa6a015c-f491-4811-97b7-8d884e3aa914?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
It's a few years old now, but this [Yair Rosenberg op-ed](https://substack.com/redirect/c7c715af-b3a9-4295-881b-8cd6e9eccf80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has always felt pretty astute: "Trump keeps pushing anti-Semitic stereotypes. But he thinks he's praising Jews."
In any event, that tactic--deploying an issue to your gain when you don't really care about it--is hardly limited to antisemitism. I can say with reasonable certainty, for instance, that Donald Trump doesn't understand or doesn't care about cryptocurrency. But he knows that they make good allies, and he's happy to make friends with them.
4
It probably reveals a more uncomfortable truth for me too: that I don't know enough, and don't think enough about, people whose communities don't look like mine--especially people who live in more rural areas.
5
There's more than a little nuance here, and the question of who is a Jew is so complicated that it [commands its own 10,000-word Wikipedia page](https://substack.com/redirect/988bec0b-90b4-4402-bc95-c8e53c8abb7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
To make things simpler, I tasked ChatGPT to come up with a one-sentence summary of that Wikipedia page: "The question 'Who is a Jew?' involves religious, cultural, and legal ideas, with different groups defining it based on ancestry, conversion, and personal identity."
6
For context, [in 1958, 96% of Jews lived in urban areas](https://substack.com/redirect/73c0a1ed-7caa-4b24-89d4-c9733524f301?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So there's been _some_ movement away from the cities into the suburbs, like there has been for every population, but there have never been a lot of Jews living in rural areas.
7
There are a ton of smaller counties that drive up the total, and help explain why 50% of counties in the U.S. have zero Jews, but only 7% of the U.S. population lives in those counties.
8
There's interesting survey data from 2022 that suggests that [Americans ](https://substack.com/redirect/02fd4d9c-3cc0-4d3a-869e-61a198dd2843?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[believe](https://substack.com/redirect/02fd4d9c-3cc0-4d3a-869e-61a198dd2843?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ that Jews make up 30% of the country](https://substack.com/redirect/02fd4d9c-3cc0-4d3a-869e-61a198dd2843?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But if you dig into this data, Americans overstate the size of basically every minority group. Most of this just comes down to the fact that it's really hard to make informed estimates when you start dealing with small numbers.
9
Of course, this makes sense. One possible parallel: a 2007 poll that has stuck with me since I first read about it, when gay marriage was far less accepted than it is today. Back then, and I'm sure still, [people who know someone who's gay were far more likely to be supportive of gay marriage](https://substack.com/redirect/3f667a97-f8a7-4c80-b7ac-fb01e304cdc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (more than twice as likely, in fact) than someone who didn't know a gay person.
10
This isn't about people knowing someone who is Jewish, per se, though that's not unimportant. I think it informs, for instance, why I support state legislation that mandates teaching people about the Holocaust.
But much more broadly, I don't really know people who live in rural areas where there aren't any (or many) Jews, and the urban-rural chasm in this country only seems to be growing.
11
For the sake of his privacy, I changed his name here. He's a private figure and it should stay that way; that allowed us to have a more candid conversation. (I've named [two](https://substack.com/redirect/163ef4a7-3163-4a6d-8c16-54238c5325c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [other](https://substack.com/redirect/b3465812-58fe-4b45-a9e3-02ff489c7ffb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) people I've interviewed in this newsletter, but they were both public figures.)
12
The Oklahoma county he grew up in has zero Jews, according to the [Berman Jewish DataBank](https://substack.com/redirect/8bec400e-28f7-4bb9-ad6d-91b2174a13bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
13
Jewish population in the county he was living in: zero.
Politically, I suspect he and I probably don't see eye-to-eye on everything, but until the other day, politics hadn't ever come up. The two counties he's lived in most recently both supported Trump with 80%+ of the vote.
14
Candidly--and this betrays my own prejudices--I worried that the answer might be George Soros. (For context, there's an entire Wikipedia page titled [George Soros conspiracy theories](https://substack.com/redirect/eca27a7c-c032-4eb2-bfc3-463acdee210e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is strongly rooted in antisemitism.)
15
When I asked again if he knew anyone who's Jewish, in his more thorough answer, Carter said, "I know a guy in the military who kind of jokes about being Jewish." Which, as a joke, raises an eyebrow or two.
When he asked for examples of what antisemitism might look like, I gave the example--and this is probably too leading on my part as an interviewer--of someone cheap being referred to as a Jew. As far as he knew, he had not. How communities like Carter's think about Jews The answer, maybe unsurprisingly, is not much. I assumed that if I asked him to name a famous Jewish person, he would've come up with someone: maybe someone like , who has widespread appeal, or , who's reasonably well known--especially in conservative circles.14 But no, when I asked, the answer was probably more predictable: Jesus Christ. That was a lot of the framing of Jewishness for Carter and others in his community. What about in school--did Jewish culture ever come up? Again, the answer is no, not really. clean_body: Your gift now matched 10X for abortion rights! | Peter, What a year. There's no quick way to summarize this year in the fight for reproductive rights. Together, we saw the good, the bad, and the downright ugly. Let's make 2025 a year with more 'GOOD.' The Good: "The terrible harms of abortion bans have become clearer by the day—and they've helped to galvanize Americans to come out and demand their reproductive freedom." –Elisabeth Smith, Director of State Policy and Advocacy In Colorado and six other states, abortion won at the ballot box. That includes a win in Missouri, where voters overturned a total abortion ban for the first time. Your support is crucial as the Center helps champion more revolutionary ballot measures and change the narrative on abortion. The Bad: "I am outraged on behalf of my fellow plaintiffs who the Court deemed not sick enough... We should not need to beg elected officials for our right to control our own bodies." –Amanda Zurawski, plaintiff in Zurawski v. State of Texas The Texas Supreme Court once again failed pregnant Texans, denying claims the Center brought on behalf of 20 patients who were denied abortion care despite facing dangerous pregnancy complications. The case makes plain that Texas's 'medical exceptions' to its extreme abortion bans just don't work. And with the new lawsuit filed by the Texas Attorney General against a shield law provider in New York state, pregnant people in Texas—and in other states with abortion bans—continue to be put in danger. The Ugly: "Women have already died in TX and GA because of abortion bans. That's just what's been reported. It's the tip of the iceberg." –Nancy Northup, President & CEO This year, the Center tracked 350 abortion-related bills nationwide that ranged from restricting medication abortion to criminalizing abortion support and codifying other tactics that would make it difficult—if not impossible—to access life-saving reproductive care. While only 28 of these bills passed in 12 states, we know the consequences will be devastating. Women are already dying because of existing laws, and anti-abortion activists are gaining momentum. We expect them to escalate their attacks even further in the new year. With your help, we can make 2025 a year of progress and hope. Thank you, Center for Reproductive Rights | "DONATE NOW" | | | | ---|---|--- The Center for Reproductive Rights uses the power of law to advance reproductive rights as fundamental human rights around the world. name: Hillsdale College via ICYMI News
subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a National Referendum on Religious Liberty.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zj7e45h2djggj6avl3209bas1er85mpojqhm6mn0_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge4pb4cph2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8st5datkcd02b24sm9s329fgg1j0l2ppaaldf4o_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge4pb4cph2bs) The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://info.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z98nh4kva1ndm2gh0fflvmdolviu8c72bnfj8tpg_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge4pb4cph2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://info.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcvs8upkgtfm7r4etilpf3mvp8oak9u3833shl80_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge4pb4cph2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The difference heaven makes today
body:
Imagine you’re planning a move to a new country
| | | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=a0e53e34e11243399fb5a5f893271f74&_e=hVlnSrEQwKde2Hke16Kbbrt4qAQG8J-70Xcq8p1tUnAIisKhGMaZMRuEWy4B5y5PnggvQUSmhrFk9MVDU_wLSQbnbYN5wGK6N-R5V5SRPV44WRyhIQhGH3hNoLGzJNN_7ar-juAyGcrc242ZLFxR01lTGYVx7sQZlTlqkLqzNqlnidtYMho2YovMJKhWfdI-VE37DQnMVUM3IFR1k5V-kpT_1QfaUDg6IX2Bqoediq8OX4LKdPY4MCx9esOiEOBu22dWcs1UHUX61O4-Da1zmGskU9dz1sPCq-inpNegGopWOMkHgggqG0bP4TKoq7RI_vP3gcmdlQMJ7cS92flTk8LnlbHY07f8x4Mwvg7q6zdTa6LqqVToqo4F9Q7K1Hp2iv0OlU0wa9P4PeWdEEuhBfFZGOa-1gMtWvIL7EGAAI8%3D)
---
Hello Friend,

Imagine you're planning a move to a new country--a faraway place you've never visited before. Wouldn't you want to know everything you could about it--what the culture is like, the language, the climate, and most importantly, how to get there? It would make a huge difference in how you prepare for the journey!

As Christians, we know that one day we will leave this world and be united with God in heaven. But surprisingly, many of us know very little about what awaits us in that incredible place.
---
| | In my book _A Place Called Heaven_ , I dive into Scripture to answer 10 surprising questions about heaven, including:

* Is heaven a real place or just a state of mind?
* Will we know our loved ones when we get there?
* Do people in heaven know what's happening on earth?
* What difference does a future heaven make in our lives today?

---

I consider myself lucky to have the opportunity to do this job every day.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241230-1&t=1&akid=1589%2E587540%2E1gdcFx)
Peter, I consider myself lucky to have the opportunity to do this job every day.
Looking back at 2024, I am full of gratitude to this team for allowing me to travel across the country and support the next generation of bold progressive leaders.
I joined volunteers in Texas, Ohio, and Georgia (to name a few) and got to visit all kinds of neighborhoods to talk to regular people about the issues impacting them.
I heard a lot of things knocking doors, but there was a major common theme among the voters I talked to: **the desire for a new generation of leaders who will do what they say they are going to do and fight for our progressive values.**
That’s why the work we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve is so important, Peter. **We are changing the face of political power together, one election at a time.**
Here’s a look back at some fun moments from the campaign trail this past year:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1589&amount=5&refcode2=1589_587540_1gdcFx&akid=1589%2E587540%2E1gdcFx)
_Canvassing in Houston with Molly Cook_
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1589&amount=5&refcode2=1589_587540_1gdcFx&akid=1589%2E587540%2E1gdcFx)
_Launching a volunteer event in Atlanta with Bryce Berry_
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1589&amount=5&refcode2=1589_587540_1gdcFx&akid=1589%2E587540%2E1gdcFx)
_Knocking doors in Ohio with Christine Cockley_
We made some incredible progress together this year, electing six young leaders to Congress and state legislatures across the country. But we have so much more work to do in 2025, 2026, and beyond. **_We can’t let this momentum slow down._**

Based podcaster Tim Pool tore woke YouTuber Luke Beasley limb-from-limb during a heated, no-holds-bared screaming match about whether January 6 protesters deserve to rot in prison forever.
"You just made a fascist argument!!" Pool snapped at Beasley, who claimed Jan 6ers deserved decades-long prison sentences for largely non-violent offenses.
**[Watch Pool LOSE HIS MIND at the smug young liberal:](https://substack.com/redirect/265de9c9-2418-40fb-adb6-651b2ddf4d24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Pool called out Beasley for not even being informed about what January 6 protesters were actually in prison for, merely echoing the claims made by the left-wing media without knowledge of the substance.
"This is the problem I have with the left!!" Pool shouted at Beasley. "They don't know the facts, they don't care about the facts. They view morality as a blanket government stroke of the pen and 'every person regardless of their crime should be in prison for decades!!"
"The people who fought cops should go to prison,... they did! It's been 3 years!" he continued.
Some **1265 defendants** were charged related to their involvement in the January 6 riot. Of which, **452 defendants** were charged with assaulting, resisting, or impeding officers or employees. | | Friend,

I am reaching out to you personally today to ask for your re-commitment and support in sustaining our collective work in 2025 and beyond.

Power will be built in the struggle in 2025. Approaching the new year, I think about our staff who are community leaders from within the neighborhoods we center. As trusted messengers, they have engaged in thousands of meaningful conversations with their friends and neighbors around the importance of engaging in the democratic process. As a second chance organization that hires, coaches and mentors some staff members who are formerly incarcerated, or experiencing mental health issues, or are currently in recovery, I’m honored to lead a dedicated staff who are able to do meaningful and important work and earn a living wage with benefits. As we approach the new year, I reflect on all the Pennsylvanians I met on the ground whose lives quite literally have been changed knowing they are able to vote, that their voices matter, and their votes were counted.

In my travels across the Commonwealth, I often carry around a posterboard of one of my personal civil rights icons, civil rights activist and West Chester native, Bayard Rustin that states, “The proof that one truly believes is in action.” The New PA Project Education Fund is fully committed to year-round voter engagement and civic education across PA and will continue to take action in standing up for voting rights, and expanded access to the ballot to ensure Black, Indigenous, and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth vote in every election, twice a year.

**A family foundation in Pittsburgh has pledged to match every dollar raised up to $25,000, meaning that if we hit our goal today, we can raise $50,000 to keep our work going.**

[**We are just beginning to witness the enduring impact our work will have on Pennsylvania for generations to come. Here is why that matters:

**Engaging voters year-round:** Your gift supports year-round voter engagement efforts across the Commonwealth, centering Black, Indigenous, and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth to ensure all eligible voters feel compelled to exercise their freedom to vote in the Commonwealth.

**Preparing for 2025:** In 2025, PA will elect judges and justices in partisan elections and participate in nonpartisan judicial retention elections, including three PA Supreme Court seats, which will undoubtedly make national news and attract dark money funders like PA’s richest man, Jeffrey Yaas to disrupt our judicial races. We need to make sure that our communities do not lose hope and turnout in 2025 for our local, municipal, and judicial elections.

**Defending against attacks on voting rights:** Attacks on voting rights will only continue as we head into the critical local, municipal, and judicial elections next year. We must be prepared to go on the offensive and defend voting rights by pushing for a PA Voting Rights Act (VRA). A state VRA would ensure protections for historically disenfranchised communities who have been underrepresented and underserved in the Commonwealth throughout history.

[**We cannot sustain this work without your support. body:
Brace yourself because 2025 will be a WHOLE new ballgame!

| |
---
| | | I tried to do everything in my power to avoid this...

This is the last message I wanted to send you today but our backs are up against the wall. We're about to fall 10-15% SHORT of our final fundraising goal of the year!

**[So if you're able, I'm humbly asking you to contribute ten or twenty bucks before our final deadline of 2024.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z34903etq2chku0apcjq5cvbrf5jmsjmdefs599g_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clgeaoj6c5h2bs "So if you’re able, I’m humbly asking you to contribute ten or twenty bucks before our final deadline of 2024.") After that, our numbers go public - and the Radical Democrats are chomping at the bit for any sign of weakness so they can swoop in and DESTROY our House Majority.**

To put it plainly, if we come up even 1% short of our goal, they'll claim House Republicans are doomed, twist the narrative, and try to kneecap our Majority before we even get off the ground.

If we don't catch up now, I'm afraid it'll only get worse... _So if you thought 2024 was bad when they tried to:_

- Imprison President Trump
- Censor Conservative voices
- Weaponize the government against Americans
- Allow non-citizens to vote in our elections
- Pack the Supreme Court

**... Brace yourself because 2025 will be a whole new ballgame!**

This fight won't be easy - it never is. House Democrats have already plotted their plan to take back the Speaker's gavel AND we're going toe-to-toe with Liberal dark money groups that have ALREADY mobilized to flip key battleground districts.

**_[But what you do right now can have a direct and immediate impact on the future of our country- just a few bucks make a world of a difference.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z45epc0m8401rcohfglpnfkqudj2qim0bpcnr2go_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clgeaoj6c5h2bs "But what you do right now can have a direct and immediate impact on the future of our country – just a few bucks makes a world of a difference.")_ **And if you don't have anything to spare right now, know you are still a valued member of this team.

I couldn't be more grateful or more honored to fight alongside you.

Thank you for everything you do.

For America,

Steve Scalise

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=55d7d7615ee2415db3f15dcdae4a0864&_e=txIJw8r4cwUHt5iITRDCIc0VMcJRRmR2iCzP8wfuKesU69ZWOpT6cAS3kwYE7UQ29Y7ERFbKoCo7jy1rBgqppGXZEf7jN7H5rn0kHHCrPHZyriXkK1oDmlClQtVVqOgtKlGpryViARi4EcsUpkYHBe1ccZ_G8rP3KaJinrhaCXr9-u7wTmT6EI1bnGEKtjkL7ak-s1N8LPbhOu3UFTEg_di3v_4xZRRyupFP_lX7TqdXSh8-sSoFHerXYnVjdRvR-JGhrh5cHNVYU9ow9Ija2I3KZvjqAEw95mEhXt4w3vFn691kExvc87g3tjsuockdp-ZpGKHsFEZKCJhMqnyFPdzlCp0fWxEkun-1Bc_9MlsDnfdTVhUvc4lSR0ON75KQf4TK6Z4CV8YLkkOT5Gn5JQ%3D%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=55d7d7615ee2415db3f15dcdae4a0864&_e=txIJw8r4cwUHt5iITRDCIc0VMcJRRmR2iCzP8wfuKesU69ZWOpT6cAS3kwYE7UQ29Y7ERFbKoCo7jy1rBgqppGXZEf7jN7H5rn0kHHCrPHZyriXkK1oDmlClQtVVqOgtKlGpryViARi4EcsUpkYHBe1ccZ_G8rP3KaJinrhaCXr9-u7wTmT6EI1bnGEKtjkL7ak-s1N8LPbhOu3UFTEg_di3v_4xZRRyupFP_lX7TqdXSh8-sSoFHerXYnVjdRvR8tE9m9kLzpK3HPnQz7oUShAfyZ_5Y8uRVO5qtm13StyEW4wBZo28B_bMjh1aHw4hTi4_SY3VPUsGIVtE3XqDWtWMrZmfbbCnebEC8rw6E0ClVRqBxAOZV5QXcQ-FzKnDxmF-r4jcoZx8-b8lvAnmPQ%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---

David Horowitz

name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: A well-timed donation to the DNC is the best choice as we prepare for Trump’s first 100 days
body:
What we do now will make all the difference.
---
Derek, If your inbox looks anything like ours, it’s stuffed with fundraising requests from organizations making last-minute requests for donations before our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of 2024. We hope you’ll give us a chance to explain why a well-timed donation to the Democratic National Committee is the best choice for those looking to build the strongest possible Democratic Party to elect the school board members and city councilors, state legislators, governors, and members of Congress who will be the ultimate check on Donald Trump. Here’s the truth: What we do now — how we prepare for the first 100 days of the Trump administration — will make all the difference. Trump will undoubtedly put forward a flurry of executive orders aimed at weakening our democracy and our rights. We have to be ready to fight back. Democrats all over the country are gearing up to fight Trump’s Project 2025 agenda. The DNC is the only organization with nationwide reach and resources to support and elect those Democrats everywhere, next year and beyond. This work is not flashy. It’s hard. And it’s only possible if we have the resources to get it done. So, with our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of 2024 coming up fast, we have to ask: [**Can Democrats nationwide count on you to contribute to the DNC before tomorrow’s end-of-quarter deadline? We’ll put every dollar to work building the resources we’ll need to prepare for _anything_ coming our way in Trump’s first 100 days in office.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-december-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20241230_2420_fr&refcode2=2420_22930333_7xD2hs&akid=2420%2E22930333%2E7xD2hs) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-december-2024?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20241230_2420_fr&refcode2=2420_22930333_7xD2hs&akid=2420%2E22930333%2E7xD2hs)**

Dear Friend, Gavin Newsom and radical leftist governors are not hiding their plans to wage lawfare against conservatives at a level we’ve never before seen before.They're proudly announcing their plans to "Trump proof" their states.The time for resting or taking a post-election victory lap is over.Now is the time to fight, fight, fight. **But I need to know in the next 24 hours if you're with us...** ...because we've never had an opportunity like this one to protect the First Amendment, defend parental rights, and put a stop to the gender-industrial complex's mutilation of vulnerable children.I pray you're with us -- because the Center for American Liberty can't take on the radical left without you.
---
[ **ROLL CALL - Yes, I'm with you!**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ziug71nr0tdp7hpjunhl3ujbpvniulqj4usse71o_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge1o76cph2bs)
---
I'm the Executive Director and General Counsel for the Center for American Liberty -- a conservative non-profit law firm that protects your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation.We will continue to lead the charge against the left’s "lawfare" -- as it increases its efforts to leverage the legal system to force D.E.I. and "woke" nonsense upon us.But with more than 35 active cases -- including some of the most consequential of our time -- your support is more important than ever before as we close in on the end of 2024.Make no mistake, the left is plotting how to use the courts to ram its radical agenda down our throats. **But the Center for American Liberty can stop them --[which is why I need to know in the next 24 hours if you’re with us.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0ik24lkgu2p0j1t4dvogvt07b0dg4os9ecu91qg_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clge1o76cph2bs)**Friend, every freedom you cherish is on the line...
---
* Your right to free speech
* Your right to gather and peacefully protest
* Your right to post on social media without government censorship
* Your right to raise your children in accordance with your values
* For women, your right to privacy and safety in share spaces like locker rooms and restrooms
* For children, the right to grow up without being drugged and surgically mutilated by gender clinics

---
The left wants to erase these rights. They want to shred the Constitution. And worst of all, they want to remove God from every corner of American society. And the moment President Trump puts his hand on the Bible on January 20th, the stakes go up.If you think the left is actively working to silence you, brainwash your children, and force men into women’s private spaces right now... just wait.This is why the Center for American Liberty must be prepared not only to fight back as legal battles arise... ...but to go on the offensive to defend freedom, protect families, and challenge government overreach whenever it arises.But to be effective, I'm counting on your support.
---

---
Friend, this is a pivotal moment for America. I pray you'll to stand with us and fight, fight, fight to expand our vital, freedom-saving work.
---

Hey Peter, it's
Rashida!

Tomorrow at midnight, we’re closing the books on our final fundraising
report of the year. Everything we raise between now and then will be
critical to sustaining the future of our Squad.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20241230-movement.1NrVnT&refcode=em20241230-1167&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1167%2E342411%2Edg9yn1 ]Will you rush an end-of-year donation to help us close the remaining
$4,677 gap on our $50,000 fundraising goal?

Peter, here’s
the truth: Our Squad is 100% grassroots funded — and we’re damn proud of
it. But we’ve seen the impact that billionaires can have on our elections
and what they're willing to spend to silence the voices of our Squad and
everyday people.

We fight to fund communities not bombs. We fight to fund clean water,
schools, housing, child care and more. We deserve a Congress with members
that aren't funded by corporations.

We must stand united to defend our Squad of diverse, working-class
progressives from the far right and protect our communities from their
divisive policies. Because we deserve better than the status quo.

Our Squad is ready to take bold, strategic action to bring progressive and
people-centered solutions to the forefront — whether it’s fighting for
climate justice, defending reproductive rights, ensuring affordable
housing, or continuing to push for policies that put people before
profits. But we need your help to make this our reality.

our strategic work towards protecting our communities, fighting back
against the far right, and amplifying progressive leaders up and down the
ballot.

Together,

Rashida Tlaib
Squad Victory Fund

Dear Friend,

It's cold and quiet in Hillsdale, Michigan today. I hope you're staying warm, and that you and your family are doing well. Our students have headed home for a much-needed break, and I wanted to send you a quick note as we approach the close of 2024.

The end of one year and the beginning of another is a natural time to reflect. When I think back over the year that was, I never could've predicted we'd be where we are today. Did you think we'd see...

Campus protests, legacy media censorship, wars in Europe and the Middle East, and multiple assassination attempts of a presidential candidate?

I certainly didn't!

At the same time...

This year ended with so many Americans showing they haven't given up on this country. A renewed hope is in the air. There is a feeling that we can and will accomplish great things again.

I don't know about you, but when I remember America and its leaders in my prayers, I am so grateful to God to live in a country where the people can still choose those leaders and where we can enjoy so much personal freedom.

Even with the events of the last few years, our country remains "the last, best hope on earth," to quote one of our country's greatest presidents--Abraham Lincoln.

Like America in Lincoln's time, our country is once again going through a time of crisis and division. That's why next year if we're going to restore liberty, we must educate all who wish to learn. [We must make it possible for them to do so for FREE if it is within our power.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=87a616c01df5457cabb70840189ed163&_e=aTAmvDPoTSRmnfrQCBQQhBuZG3EbepoHpUEX-1jVKgIy21wJO_prVsvazrGEjS37Di-mja7brp4Wpl502tKmIFJsuH84PmyAr7123QD2I7Lmhea_UH7p1vf8bTi5iQpEnV3XutU0x-HTEvYN8WkgKZce3-toQT1iZtzwfbUt5Fx1K-PCq25bC5eTBttlV4uRmePRD77qs6gplV0HhfUPO4C8CFZt6Nobgr6g6lIszk3NNwOH5LWMHLeR0y3fK-J8c5aDWxoqZCUeNkro_DT42jUyxWWAt8I7ywpDho72xRWHyJ49S_Ax9BJ1i2U1H9dCyc8ZEV-xmQmtFh4WQJqRLRDX9-qScIsVxUueVh_HdM02gFX-Dnu3bUEBSmx0ilrSBM3yONOtoOdzf7LJ7Hpryw%3D%3D)

And that means that you and I must do all we can to teach the next generation the principles of liberty, something that Hillsdale does better than any other college in America.

We're committed to doing this no matter the cost because it's part of our 180-year-old mission to preserve "the blessings of liberty" we enjoy in America.

Our extensive **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education** is one of the most effective ways to engage the far-Left on the battlefield of education.

Through _Imprimis_ , free online courses, the Hillsdale College Podcast Network, and classical K-12 educational outreach, we are "developing minds and improving hearts," one community, one school, one classroom, one student at a time.

And this is multiplied by thousands and thousands...

If possible, could you consider making a generous tax-deductible gift before December 31? Hillsdale's mission is so important, and I know you stand with us. Your timely donation will help us continue to expand these programs in this **critical time for our nation while helping us reach our ambitious year-end fundraising goal.**

**If you 're able, please make your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $100, or even $250 before midnight on December 31. **

**We still have not reached our $6,000,000 goal, and time is running out.**

I've included a secure link for you to see our progress and to make your gift safely:

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=87a616c01df5457cabb70840189ed163&_e=aTAmvDPoTSRmnfrQCBQQhBuZG3EbepoHpUEX-1jVKgIy21wJO_prVsvazrGEjS37Di-mja7brp4Wpl502tKmIFJsuH84PmyAr7123QD2I7Lmhea_UH7p1vf8bTi5iQpEnV3XutU0x-HTEvYN8WkgKZce3-toQT1iZtzwfbUt5Fx1K-PCq25bC5eTBttlV4uRmePRD77qs6gplV0HhfUPO4C8CFZt6Nobgr6g6lIszk2mynDJKJj2Ib3ioSySIWW0k0zjDEAwcx3ObzIbDEsPlOCA_7RklHn4O-8lcdgAjcNHTMQhBHA2F8HGVKh99ZuHVQCQiY4zZ6WzXVVwRfesnZJiG4u_PVjbYRnUA14j2yATcaC5qyEl1mUA6lBYXmWOt0aYR6-uEWBMwWaDdT7Pgg%3D%3D)

Please know how thankful I am to have you as a friend. Together, we can educate for liberty in America. Enjoy the rest of your day!

Looking forward to hearing from you,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. There's more that we have to do to secure liberty in America in 2025. That's why we have an ambitious $6,000,000 online fundraising goal. So, would you be willing to make a gift to help reach and teach even more people? Here's a secure link for you to chip in a $50, $100, or even $250 gift:

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=87a616c01df5457cabb70840189ed163&_e=aTAmvDPoTSRmnfrQCBQQhBuZG3EbepoHpUEX-1jVKgIy21wJO_prVsvazrGEjS37Di-mja7brp4Wpl502tKmIFJsuH84PmyAr7123QD2I7Lmhea_UH7p1vf8bTi5iQpEnV3XutU0x-HTEvYN8WkgKZce3-toQT1iZtzwfbUt5Fx1K-PCq25bC5eTBttlV4uRmePRD77qs6gplV0HhfUPO4C8CFZt6Nobgr6g6lIszk2Uzrgoc9d-wlbizZxzbDe5hfeuVTXjEmvsksbpJN8n41joWqu8KJp3-WuBsn4IvfGoQtNK9Etgf6cNpjdt_s8onWiYlSoROHAdyacYrHnVSZ4WeiOkPyIWgeWZ_1xh3YySPPtIqu2TGeTDWoSwePkwJ5IFO3of3JRUkESDMMlFKA%3D%3D)

Thank you!

body:

| Dear Friend, I’ll get straight to the point. We’re hours away from our year-end goal, and we still need to raise $35,000 before the end of the year.

**Here’s why we need to raise this amount: America’s universities are the epicenter of our country’s problems.**

* 54 percent of 18-24 year olds have a negative view of free market capitalism.
* Less than one in five 18-34 year olds feel “extremely proud” to be an American.
* Many young Americans are not taught about 1776 and this nation’s founding.

Here at the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, we educate young people about free markets and American exceptionalism. As well as pushing for the free market reforms our state needs to prosper, we reach the hearts and minds of young Mississippians.

To make this happen in 2025, we need to raise a total of $100,000 before the end of the year. The good news is that we are two thirds of the way there already!

**To help us reach our goal, EVERY TAX-DEDUCTABLE DOLLAR YOU DONATE WILL BE MATCHED, doubling its impact!**

One local supporter had offered $25,000 in matching funding. **_Now a second supporter has come forward with an offer to increase the amount of matching funding from $25,000 to $50,000._**

**This means that EVERY DOLLAR WE RECEIVE WILL BE DOUBLED up to $50,000!**

Please use this link to make a gift:

subject: Every freedom you cherish is on the line
body:
Gavin Newsom and radical leftist governors are not hiding their plans to wage lawfare against conservatives at a level we’ve never before seen before.

| |

Dear Friend, Gavin Newsom and radical leftist governors are not hiding their plans to wage lawfare against conservatives at a level we’ve never before seen before.They're proudly announcing their plans to "Trump proof" their states.The time for resting or taking a post-election victory lap is over.Now is the time to fight, fight, fight. **But I need to know in the next 24 hours if you're with us...** ...because we've never had an opportunity like this one to protect the First Amendment, defend parental rights, and put a stop to the gender-industrial complex's mutilation of vulnerable children.I pray you're with us -- because the Center for American Liberty can't take on the radical left without you.
---
[ **ROLL CALL - Yes, I'm with you!**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8s0sna9u1n6g6j1p93glnecgg5phsqevo5lakn8_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clie4ob1c1h2bs)
---
I'm the Executive Director and General Counsel for the Center for American Liberty -- a conservative non-profit law firm that protects your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation.We will continue to lead the charge against the left’s "lawfare" -- as it increases its efforts to leverage the legal system to force D.E.I. and "woke" nonsense upon us.But with more than 35 active cases -- including some of the most consequential of our time -- your support is more important than ever before as we close in on the end of 2024.Make no mistake, the left is plotting how to use the courts to ram its radical agenda down our throats. **But the Center for American Liberty can stop them --[which is why I need to know in the next 24 hours if you’re with us.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2moorfp1rs0mkoj8u19t9e8mfjd84jesicbdmuo_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clie4ob1c1h2bs)**Friend, every freedom you cherish is on the line...
---
* Your right to free speech
* Your right to gather and peacefully protest
* Your right to post on social media without government censorship
* Your right to raise your children in accordance with your values
* For women, your right to privacy and safety in share spaces like locker rooms and restrooms
* For children, the right to grow up without being drugged and surgically mutilated by gender clinics

---
The left wants to erase these rights. They want to shred the Constitution. And worst of all, they want to remove God from every corner of American society. And the moment President Trump puts his hand on the Bible on January 20th, the stakes go up.If you think the left is actively working to silence you, brainwash your children, and force men into women’s private spaces right now... just wait.This is why the Center for American Liberty must be prepared not only to fight back as legal battles arise... ...but to go on the offensive to defend freedom, protect families, and challenge government overreach whenever it arises.But to be effective, I'm counting on your support.
---
[ **ROLL CALL - Yes, I'm with you!**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4i1cr8s2jdp0pee1osvddj1stbjhrhs6jfeijug_rp22sh2s8i6epj5clie4ob1c1h2bs)
---
Friend, this is a pivotal moment for America. I pray you'll to stand with us and fight, fight, fight to expand our vital, freedom-saving work.
---
| | Sincerely,Mark Trammell Executive Director & General Counsel

By Illinois Review

Legendary Republican strategist and political icon Roger Stone welcomes Illinois Review editor-in-chief Mark Vargas to the hit podcast, The StoneZONE – where he’ll share co-host duties beginning after the new year.

“In 2020, after I was indicted on false and fake charges in the now-discredited Mueller Witch Hunt, Mark Vargas was one of the people that I reached out to help me navigate the legal and political waters in my fight for freedom,” said Stone. “Mark is a respected political strategist with deep insights on the inner workings of Washington, and I am delighted to welcome him to The StoneZone family as one of my weekday co-hosts alongside the great editor-in-chief of Slingshot.News Troy Smith, one of the fastest growing alternative media outlets in the country.”

Dear
Friend,

Staying
connected to Jesus each day is essential for growing in our faith
and reflecting His light in the world around us. One way we can
strengthen that connection is through daily Bible reading and
devotionals that speak God's truth into our hearts-setting aside
intentional time with God's Word to keep our minds focused on
Him.

With that in mind, I'm excited to offer
you the brand-new 2025 Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional. This
beautiful devotional, featuring 260 daily messages (one for every
weekday of the year), is designed to help you grow in your faith
and keep your focus on God all year long. Each season will
provide fresh insights to encourage and strengthen you:

In the winter, discover God's will
for your life. That's something we all want to know!

Through spring and summer, deepen
your relationship with Jesus through the book of Colossians.

In the fall, journey through the
parable of the prodigal son and experience the unconditional love
of your heavenly Father.

For your gift of any amount, we'd love
to send you this devotional as our thank-you. Every day, you'll
find inspiration to carry you through life's challenges and
opportunities.

This year's edition is beautifully
bound in navy blue with gold trim that would not only grace your
nightstand, where you can access it every morning or evening, but
it would also make an attractive gift to give to someone you know
and love.

Request your copy here:
https://secure.ptv.org/2025-navy-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional-generous-gift-1

Thank you for being a part of this
ministry. I'm praying that this new devotional will be a daily
anchor point of encouragement and wisdom for all who read it.

God bless you,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

| | Friend, as 2024 comes to an end, I want to highlight what is most important as we head into 2025. **We'll be defending against Donald Trump and Republicans' attempts to cut taxes for the richest 1%, and****efforts by Trump and his allies to hijack government for _their_ benefit, rather than for the benefit of the American people.** It's going to be a tough fight, and to succeed, we have to stand together.

For working families and neighborhoods in Philadelphia, my promise remains the same today as the day I took office: **I'm here to work for you, and it's the privilege of a lifetime to fight for Philadelphia and Pennsylvania in Washington.** **As we wrap up this year, I'm asking one last time for your support. We have a big task to restore a Democratic House majority in 2026, and that work begins right now.** So in addition to wishing you and your family a happy new year, I hope you'll stand with me as we enter 2025. There WILL be opportunities to fight back. To check and curb Trump's power. And to retake the House, Senate, and White House. But only if we put in the work, together. | | | Hello Peter, it's Elizabeth Warren. In a few moments, [**I’m going to ask if you can make an end-of-year contribution to the Working Families Party before Tuesday night’s deadline — because we all need to prepare right now to fight back effectively against the attacks coming our way in 2025.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9IMCZqG23MZNa_R3nK0XZCN1Llm_iq605UX_h9nau6NJeIcQixzkYgT7NeV3s0Q6Fm_EVt2R70GTps114GQoBVcSXyHjHSce8Iu-fHw3nZmGEXhZRDOeHsgYw-g-fIl5TofqKthKJI2y0e2pR17daqdW8dYgxh4mhIXKdMn1pY2Vkbsim3VHnnd2jzzCKcMEolt5gg9qIPA5Qqvaw_CdsZ6SC9YUkERLwq27ctOK_x-UeVLG356EvOCuQwSKaq3cRY9xhoiAbwm83dBNZx8Kz4MFXJvQjSugA5oT7kpVOCkVBifuX_r6EAxCNT_mVFvKcnMr_Gu46pAGa7nODDMLLMs39MYuEmcK6t01VO4RZ-Xu_w0CH3Ajiq9wFrEQnJdNAVJiRn_lX_VVjfVt3A8eYcg/4cq/HW6y4wn3TsWiHevgCLpGnw/h0/h001.1eYjUXeDMgDpZNMK-Zu4_3Myv-E6NzlpJTk5PGnKuaY) But first, I wanted to take a minute or two to talk with you directly about our shared fight for working families, and why it is so important that every one of us pitch in however we can. When I first ran for Senate, it was because I saw how the system was rigged for the wealthy and well-connected against everyone else. We won because Massachusetts voters saw it too. And even though we’ve been up against powerful forces, **it has always been true that when we organize, fight righteous fights, and hold those in power accountable, we can make positive change.** I need all of you to remember that. Because, given what just happened in November, what we do next is critically important. **First** , and most importantly, we need to prove the far right wrong. They think we won’t have the stomach to keep fighting. It’s on all of us to show them otherwise. Don’t forget, the political position we’re in is not permanent, and we have the power to make change if we fight for it. **Second** , we need to fight every fight in Congress — something that we know how to do. After Trump won eight years ago, we got to work immediately to contest special elections and build the coalition that laid the groundwork for Democrats to take back the House and dismantle the Republican trifecta in the 2018 midterms. We need to bring that same widespread energy again. **Third** , we need our elected leaders to prove to everyone — voters, activists, and party leaders alike — that we will actually fight for working families. For my entire career, I’ve studied how the system is rigged against working-class families. On paper, the U.S. economy is the strongest in the world. And yet millions are struggling to get by. Now, Trump’s billionaire hangers-on and corporate donors are already scheming to get his administration to make them even richer — to pick the pockets of working people. But it’s on us to prove that we’re different, and then put it into practice. I won’t promise that every effort of ours to combat Trump will end in success. But there WILL be opportunities to fight back. To check and curb his power. And to retake the House, Senate, and White House. But only if we put in the work, together. **The Working Families Party is at the forefront of so many of these battles, Peter.** They organize in key working-class communities, month after month, even after the bright lights of the campaign have dimmed. They have had my back — and they’ll have ALL of our backs on the road ahead. [**That’s why I’m hoping you’ll make a donation today to continue to fuel their vital work. The end-of-year fundraising deadline is just a day away, and your support now will help power our shared fights in 2025.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9IMCZqG23MZNa_R3nK0XZCN1Llm_iq605UX_h9nau6NJeIcQixzkYgT7NeV3s0Q6FcsqkuhcfRo7UxwFrcfLGtYRuwgLy78e9fyoAnsKWtoPAIKaBhmTO4bNuXdI5RdMYSMZbA04wYpDk7HGHVTse3agWQTQW7ox_XaDytWOIPAtCvHhiL-UdHqvzRcw2HtEHJAq_fol8qpSB03QKVnmaMBDNdl3iKOX8gEf2N28grS9T8JBR0CLVd8XVlSIHdy8LyhxJbCOBKvj_v2LyaepdyUdFJlxvdR_ykEVz-zuGnMvW3LmjBQA_ck7yAHrdtSBF6BAscRmAlwGgeFWdhbfG2WzuyJbMP_UXNAYJyovI8tQy3v5XXEtheNJeH5rAeWxVTxS85Pt11raz-xM0T0pLSQ/4cq/HW6y4wn3TsWiHevgCLpGnw/h1/h001.mxQwy2oswyFmuUTzmX6h_YG5aVLcZWqUuy4A8wY6Z8A) **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9IMCZqG23MZNa_R3nK0XZCN1Llm_iq605UX_h9nau6NJeIcQixzkYgT7NeV3s0Q6FjNtQDCq0lbm1uaxXdcYQGom_NR94doOlN13QqIyhjNR_195YBB1HDEGagrPZAzGE-k17HJiBuz90ECJKACdh5CxcVzqBoJ_j157RiU5GRRPZjdszpW_tsuhSOlN4yBcLzz4BaSu8VN70L2gxoT87mBFNMSmeFCfX0eYbZTB1dkfnFUZfStTAc-kDMegBggZVSwLr02KVQN3SguvyMb5qO20B4jBhqjeZ3ITnAwp9hUqhRLRmOhR4iUoPaRRVmckzpFFqoEA6CdvDGpvDkIh3aqCwFwmed_OowI7adKyW_4L_t4D0TfkiGH5tibHrumdlFfbXSSS6SopHg3Jj7r5JoA/4cq/HW6y4wn3TsWiHevgCLpGnw/h2/h001.arbrpMN_PSjnc47K83NYlYODPZa-H9Lz_p8uE8orrHQ)** Thanks for being a part of this. _December 30th, 2024_

It’s important you download your concealed carry certificate before it's banned for good.

Due to increased pressure from lawmakers, a website offering you a certificate for America’s Top CCW Gun Permit **could be shut down at any moment.**

Which is why it’s important you download your **Concealed Carry Certificate ASAP**.

Wait even one more day and we won’t be able to guarantee this certificate will be available to download.

This certificate is great for gun owners because it takes advantage of a little-known (but 100% legal) loophole - **[allowing you to get a CCW certification from this website](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/19535/6374453/bb5736be8f45c70b630e3e79f5b04710e4e59c9c/239aacdaa18ddd8986ae80304ffe52d484d7f7d7). You don’t even have to leave your house to do it!**

This loophole ensures you encounter:
* Zero government red tape (and no exposing your private info to the Feds)...
* Zero lines, classroom time or books to read...
* Zero gun range time (you don’t even need to fire a gun to get this permit).

**[It’s as simple as visiting this site and answering a few questions (they’re simple)](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/19535/6374453/bb5736be8f45c70b630e3e79f5b04710e4e59c9c/239aacdaa18ddd8986ae80304ffe52d484d7f7d7).**

Plus you can complete the entire certification process online.

Download it directly to your phone or computer in as little as 30 minutes.

**You don’t even need to own a gun to get this permit...** that’s why it’s named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Permit.

31 states have agreed to accept this permit so far. That’s because it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized permit that’s available right now.

This permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry permit either. **It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.**

**Hurry and get it now.**

**[There are no guarantees this website](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/19535/6374453/bb5736be8f45c70b630e3e79f5b04710e4e59c9c/239aacdaa18ddd8986ae80304ffe52d484d7f7d7)** will be able to legally deliver this certificate to your email address after today!

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.
