subject: You understand the urgency of the situation
body:
Our nation is at a crossroads.

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=efbf2bb12d544b2fb92a68f6c1b0858f&_e=lux_C53sajGJHdmbCncCZBxPwcPtIki1OLRcQuHjays0q6ARJq84oO79lJKNS6dG2JvGtS08ZppO05_ZvCOjsSkaDabZMTNlgw3NMldCuJxgCMLcI01uNgUTnE9B-8XLiDZUqXywdVrEzf0zwFZ3vljS9VLi9RC9F5cW94K5nzMYEUvZ3KxAHigyCvjLdRohdfEni2YBX8Vci-qUTK3xTl_aadd2BvXmUk5AeR_HKufA9SOiUBmXJl6aX1oMngcnjdReazdKeWudl4iQDAeJqnG7vGi3DvvuvwsPeCO0HpCByf3fWZvuq0mxAGbm2aYyWr1VV7jLje0T_Sf8N1viq7c-iY2Yskd4qJE3tUlinmhjXi4VsH6Mr8d6r5gZBmV8)
---
| |
Dear Friend,

Our nation is at a crossroads. Patriotic Americans have an opportunity in 2025 to take fundamental steps in the direction of reviving and preserving liberty and free government.

It is imperative to make the most of this opportunity in order to pass on the blessings of the American way of life to future generations.

As you may know, Hillsdale College is the only educational institution in the country that is in a strong position to reach and teach millions of Americans about America's founding principles and its great heritage of liberty. And we are expanding our efforts to do just that.

To press forward with our educational mission on behalf of liberty during a critical time for America, we have set an ambitious goal to raise $6,000,000 online by December 31 to expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education** in 2025.

[Will you partner with us in defending the cause of liberty and free government nationwide through education with your year-end support and make a generous gift to Hillsdale College today?](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=efbf2bb12d544b2fb92a68f6c1b0858f&_e=lux_C53sajGJHdmbCncCZBxPwcPtIki1OLRcQuHjays0q6ARJq84oO79lJKNS6dG2JvGtS08ZppO05_ZvCOjsSkaDabZMTNlgw3NMldCuJxgCMLcI01uNgUTnE9B-8XLiDZUqXywdVrEzf0zwFZ3vljS9VLi9RC9F5cW94K5nzMYEUvZ3KxAHigyCvjLdRohdfEni2YBX8Vci-qUTK3xTl_aadd2BvXmUk5AeR_HKucamGNg1c_0Gp8ThqdY-iXo0kJkexp76w3-XYty6hLMa6DxLUFPGQWiVXFHKbsvGPqM5PTJ6l-p-MUgRdEJONL56QmKHV99J10Xd9L027kvzWez6O4-NTbsMLlv4CHjTjM-3qtsyIf7lViXMy7dUuXZ)

What all of us do today will have significant consequences for the survival of the American way of life. We have the opportunity to make 2025 a year that future American patriots will look back on with gratitude.

Make no mistake. Powerful forces who seek to undermine our way of life--not only socialist politicians but also the legacy media, the entertainment industry, and Big Tech--will be working tirelessly to undermine liberty and free government, including in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

Indeed, successfully engaging the Left on the battleground of American education is of fundamental importance if we are to revive and preserve liberty for future generations.

But success will require the faithful and generous support of patriotic Americans like you--citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty in a free republic. [That's why we're asking for your year-end support to continue and expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education**.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=efbf2bb12d544b2fb92a68f6c1b0858f&_e=lux_C53sajGJHdmbCncCZBxPwcPtIki1OLRcQuHjays0q6ARJq84oO79lJKNS6dG2JvGtS08ZppO05_ZvCOjsSkaDabZMTNlgw3NMldCuJxgCMLcI01uNgUTnE9B-8XLiDZUqXywdVrEzf0zwFZ3vljS9VLi9RC9F5cW94K5nzMYEUvZ3KxAHigyCvjLdRohdfEni2YBX8Vci-qUTK3xTl_aadd2BvXmUk5AeR_HKucSDMHXHdp9QPNBt2dUUJRaMvgZwXuW3s6gyGsoIGBYnq0Z8cIIA6IdIxqAM-K78UEGs_amuBvaZvoOXhIkrFPf5pG-MfNeViYDZgbbJETIhN4IrNQMv3HQ_tjf4npCML0AA7bdHiuwmgRORcnkYzAd)

**We must do all that we possibly can.**

With the help of friends like you, who support Hillsdale's educational mission, we are determined to redouble our efforts at this critical time for our nation.

You will help us to ...

* **Reach an additional 600,000 American households and businesses with _Imprimis_ , our monthly digest of liberty.** With your support, we plan to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to more than 7 million households and businesses in 2025.
* **Teach citizens nationwide, especially younger Americans, through our FREE online courses.** Your donation will help us to create new online courses and add 900,000 new students in 2025.
* **Restore excellence to American K-12 education.** Your faithful generosity will help us to launch and guide increasing numbers of classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Reading and watching the news reminds us every day that our work is far from finished. America remains deeply divided. The gains we've made on behalf of liberty in recent years are fragile.

**With your help, we will succeed --because we must succeed for our country!**

Hillsdale College **conducts its educational outreach efforts** --as it does all its work--while refusing to accept **one penny** of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

To meet our ambitious year-end funding goal, we will need thousands of gifts between **$25** and **$100**. Most of our supporters' contributions are in this range.

We will also need a significant number of **$500** to **$1,000** donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

Since we have less than a month remaining to fund this project for 2025, we urgently need your help.

**You can safely and securely renew your support using this link:[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=efbf2bb12d544b2fb92a68f6c1b0858f&_e=lux_C53sajGJHdmbCncCZBxPwcPtIki1OLRcQuHjays0q6ARJq84oO79lJKNS6dG2JvGtS08ZppO05_ZvCOjsSkaDabZMTNlgw3NMldCuJxgCMLcI01uNgUTnE9B-8XLiDZUqXywdVrEzf0zwFZ3vljS9VLi9RC9F5cW94K5nzMYEUvZ3KxAHigyCvjLdRohdfEni2YBX8Vci-qUTK3xTl_aadd2BvXmUk5AeR_HKuf_vbnA8leba_qVIK4UMVkK26G-YqB52Ao-UK62Esdj4ECnayY8C8P85ZiFP0ZIA5-TOJ5lCmHSZoxuoLJwbEXOycWknF1H7aHht2x62JyajJ7lkanLppeiW8yvkicY25_CGaYcbfDnJQjrxJPVs4m4)**

It is not an exaggeration to say that the future of American liberty and the American way of life depends on the efforts of patriotic Americans over the next few years.

That's why I hope you'll make your most generous year-end gift to Hillsdale College before the **December 31** deadline.

Every dollar you give will get us closer to our **$6,000,000** online fundraising goal, enabling us to expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education**.

Please partner with Hillsdale College to make 2025 a significant turning point in the revival and preservation of the American way of life.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Hey there Friend, ____ Even as we celebrate the Christmas season and reflect on the incredible gift of hope we have in Jesus Christ, I am sure you are reminded of the challenge before us: how do we live out that hope in a world that seems so increasingly distant from God?

It's a question we all wrestle with, especially as we witness significant cultural shifts that oppose our biblical convictions. In times like these, we need practical wisdom, encouragement, and a clear vision for how to live as faithful followers of Christ.

[That's where This Light of Mine: Living Like Jesus in a Non-Jesus World comes in.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=21782e5726a643f899d4894a934da403&_e=8I-BO-MzNMPijeGMroXwUmZpbihk442b8faGc3xjDhRyWpoqAzaJzMRGK98okM54w1-MBAj_XJmX8npMYKtrKFSmjN_dWPcfbMxJYMLisnUjA7MOHNNXy9ZtEKzBENBOYfYDhNyl7pcZEnBuswzyRzKq0LesxGj1kVLhRpN6l-rMkrSKjrildI9tvvIZd2n_kT1pXGXii4TYFcUkYP_jbMMEcCbnF-vdNYnXRcL4WBB_t5MEqvajPPdQ6qSwzpH-jfpYEPeIYKB9PM8l3h95xgGqh3ok7PAfMRMYjPCJtRXRiMZVhzvoLpRwS73j4OxiZ5sNu_5dqZ9HDIEEIa2X7w%3D%3D)

In this powerful book, Dr. Joseph Stowell (a name you may recognize as the former president of Moody Bible Institute) offers a timely call for Christians to stop fighting battles for an earthly kingdom and instead embrace the privilege of advancing Christ's Kingdom. Drawing from Scripture and the life of Jesus, Dr. Stowell shows how we can respond to today's challenges with hope, courage, and grace.

As we interact with a culture that often feels divided and broken,_This Light of Mine_ encourages us to reflect Jesus' love and truth in a way that draws others to the Gospel--without alienating them. It encourages us to rise above the noise and shine God's light in a world desperately in need of it.

We'd love to send you an exclusive, pre-release copy of _This Light of Mine_ as a thank-you for your generous gift of any amount to support the mission of _Today in the Word_. Your gift today will help us continue providing Bible-centered resources to readers across the globe.

Whether you're seeking practical advice for living out your faith in a complex world or simply need encouragement to stay steady in your walk with Christ, _This Light of Mine_ is a timely and powerful tool for your journey.

As we interact with a culture that often feels divided and broken,This Light of Mine encourages us to reflect Jesus' love and truth in a way that draws others to the Gospel--without alienating them. It encourages us to rise above the noise and shine God's light in a world desperately in need of it. **YOUNG DEMOCRATS OF AMERICA CONDEMN SURGE IN ONLINE HATE AGAINST IMMIGRANT COMMUNITIES**
---
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **December 30, 2024**
**Contact: Kait Ahern — communications@yda.org**
---
WASHINGTON, DC — The recent rise in hateful, racist, and Hinduphobic rhetoric targeting Indian Americans, along with other immigrant communities, particularly online over the past week, is unacceptable and deeply harmful. Immigrants have always been central to the American story, enriching our culture, driving innovation, and building stronger communities. Such divisive rhetoric undermines the values of opportunity and equality that are at the heart of our nation’s proud tradition.

The Young Democrats of America strongly denounce this hateful rhetoric and reaffirm our commitment to fostering a more equitable and just society. Together, we must reject discrimination and honor the legacy of unity and progress that has shaped our country.
---

Friend, Later this week, I’ll be sworn in for my fourth term in Congress. Thank you for sending me back to Congress to fight for you and vulnerable communities. **With you by my side, we have pushed back against the military industrial complex,** opposing each and every Pentagon budget and introducing the _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_ to ban members of Congress from investing in weapons contractors. **We have fought for the right to utilities, including water as a human right,** establishing a $1.1 billion _Low-Income Household Water Assistance Program_ to save lives and keep people’s water flowing. And, more recently, I introduced the _H2O UP Act (Half-Century Update for Water Access and Affordability Act)_ to establish the first-ever permanent federal low-income water affordability program. **I founded and co-chair the Congressional Mamas’ Caucus** to focus on policies like access to affordable childcare, paid family leave, Black maternal health, and reproductive justice. **As a member of the House Oversight Committee, I held Postmaster General Louis DeJoy accountable,** telling him, **_"I've never seen this many complaints about our Postal Service until you were in charge."_** I went on to ask DeJoy, _"[American Postal Workers Union Convention] passed a resolution calling for your resignation. Did you know that?"_ **From demanding an end to U.S. arms sales to Israel to end the genocide against the Palestinian people to holding the powerful to account,** we will never stop working toward a future where our communities have what they need, not just to survive, but to thrive. [**Tomorrow at midnight is our final fundraising deadline of the year. Will you donate $5 to power our work ahead?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvBAogjKIfAsrN_zCskQxfdqGki_be4Dkj18miz0Sowh9-12LFLlI6w2-w2ULGtnuMoLjIrAKR8fBB7zYhnoMsyKO6g73tSuo3p67q_qPDlrGUAhxDSaN7-IlFfSt0GAVOPmQ75msA-rGO03uSXtx95o7Qn0XC3yrI2ALXSEVlXOLhZih12Y2vlUm_FTlTVoXUGxUxE-QbjjBum4hOOoqg5jfkffAQ3JxZR6RBRF650H9rrAYTH-PM3hugVsZyM4UrxYRjKFaXGSx19z0CKp7PtrB3fYHw9zawR2mfUZSM_h3kaqYR4mCYCEiSp4Mse1jtX7u_3VEeN0_t6eNnPX4pd3Vno6QCB0H0zK6oxBjuoiw/4cq/mZAl2rr9TIueSiN0dzgeUw/h1/h001.a23p4_1AEiPIHygtYysn-G7h88-SCcHl0GBrWibJ-gg) | [DONATE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvBAogjKIfAsrN_zCskQxfdXgITgwhY8s_9sMbQIraUBgcnNlEpQYAAejvQcwf0h1117jMv1N28RfJlLaHjRV9sUZGF8E5E4nekZ30NVicKpltdSwIxPfv5zKFTVw7rMAr2Nd-55pc6SQypSetkZhA0XXktmI5kqw72KEhampQ-l8iKqogicrOKy1BLh_iXPMrnsgOddm1PArapUbwu4KKV7wGiriwCxox1l6g_qtC2lxxu_D2B59hCDpDsKTpj5SlQZG-AdYYQolW814Swar-docriDGy0dGvw6FcImbggnLIXusS67cM-LjnGzq9hLGcrquWPJv3D69jNbZH_HpU-KOUu1b2FJj2ATgYbnTIX0g/4cq/mZAl2rr9TIueSiN0dzgeUw/h2/h001.ZFlSfW-ers1kKNgyeP-16fSatZNELUvqgkq03NgxciQ)

This is the last message I wanted to send you today but our backs are up against the wall. We're about to fall 10-15% SHORT of our final fundraising goal of the year!

After that, our numbers go public - and the Radical Democrats are chomping at the bit for any sign of weakness so they can swoop in and DESTROY our House Majority.**

To put it plainly, if we come up even 1% short of our goal, they'll claim House Republicans are doomed, twist the narrative, and try to kneecap our Majority before we even get off the ground.

If we don't catch up now, I'm afraid it'll only get worse... _So if you thought 2024 was bad when they tried to:_

- Imprison President Trump
- Censor Conservative voices
- Weaponize the government against Americans
- Allow non-citizens to vote in our elections
- Pack the Supreme Court

**... Brace yourself because 2025 will be a whole new ballgame!**

This fight won't be easy - it never is. House Democrats have already plotted their plan to take back the Speaker's gavel AND we're going toe-to-toe with Liberal dark money groups that have ALREADY mobilized to flip key battleground districts.

**_[But what you do right now can have a direct and immediate impact on the future of our country- just a few bucks make a world of a difference.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3ff3302673604b2aa0215016822f49c6&_e=Uh-LEnsT_xL2HePBw4nmugjdse4d_arF3XqNERUkJSi1s287xJ6QQk2pEhsJbXa4Uf9HJlaP-GOu8wodVSQqi2jFoRerj6zVg_OXuSVCKo5eQ-3qDz5hCd0OzabTGcMLXf_i5FdJ6xgpAA3sFIW5k6tEWpPOOyCFxnnRotKxMdvQy1_HJz6uLNCxOtOoyeWdr6vr8Jdpe_NgeeZXbJvC5de8XBMaMhFBxTrvRh67BIH3vxUIiP3M5nzWk8AYFxLyubHxMUs29R8go6fePA_E-P4fQ_0tmHkqbEAxTsx7VkcQldK-GEcMv8UJqRsjB3qdfnitjlj3-OMDOAnPhKUkY1AAzsQkq7TgoskTmoVjgXUnpNMZ603BoOHtPyhWb0VUUIuvJqw8gU8Jll53Xt5zN1FJS4Wv_u8o46ZzVX0xn_vZxvPemrPBU3OywKD7YpBZ "But what you do right now can have a direct and immediate impact on the future of our country – just a few bucks makes a world of a difference.")_ **And if you don't have anything to spare right now, know you are still a valued member of this team.

I couldn't be more grateful or more honored to fight alongside you.

Thank you for everything you do.

For America,

Steve Scalise

If you would like to get less email, To unsubscribe, | | Folks, – I want to take a moment to thank the person who inspired me to be a public servant: Senator Tom Carper , who is officially retiring after 23 years in the Senate. For nearly 50 years, he gave his all to Delaware and this country. When I first met him, I was a young mom of two who just wanted to make my neighbors’ lives better. I ultimately applied for his internship program, and ended up working in his Wilmington office. The rest is history! Because of Tom, I learned the power of using public service to make positive change for everyone. Not only is he a hard worker and colleague who gets the job done, but he is a role model and a friend. I will miss Tom’s presence in Washington and in Delaware politics. But we will still feel his impact for generations to come. | | But if there’s one thing I learned from Senator Carper, it’s that he taught me to make my own legacy and path forward. Thank you, Tom. All the best, Lisa Blunt Rochester | = I officially became the first woman and person of color to ever represent Delaware in the Senate. But even though our campaign is over, the work has just begun. name: Larry P. Arnn
subject: Preserving liberty through education
body:
Support our educational outreach efforts

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b7a036ea30ee40f08976895d8795dab6&_e=wNFDpSDrQw5uROf_EsDGpP4MyP7ffGVBETHLzZyCuI5JOTf-tqF2gw_BFU26irYfpHkZG3ZwHUuHt10md77_dTfm-pTM5M68dj6QRrb2vZ9YQb8tbDTUXgU7Yjs0De3y0AFKoUDv0NsslPSugnNeWvO3uiBTWVV682FfzAGCzDFdroFVYNQrNj4bEbVAVQhWahxoAi0U4XOTHBgPEH7Z1X_XoN6CdfevHRq8d__3QI11vJ1QJ1OEL39KR0igpV_DTAnlkxksidMqNOzS-ERwoMJ_CoZ2RtW2ekQunoq6EyVHhbbQOlhAbJbEnpfvKs_4SeeSyM6JidtSDNmV1oW1Z3rwae7vVn9wRiCb-mvKm-ofbROltOXk3OP8b3A3V9307H_dMXNqqWr8z3yPJvRtkA%3D%3D)
---
| |
Peter,

You know that most institutions of higher education have been hotbeds of anti-Americanism for decades.

In recent years, the radical ideologies hatched in higher education have spread into the mainstream of American life.

The need to push back aggressively has become urgent.

Next year, we must do even more for the cause of liberty and the American way of life. And I think the opportunities are significantly better than in the past.

**We must do all we can to revive and preserve the principles and practices of liberty and limited constitutional government on the battlefield of education. **

Hillsdale College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. With the help of friends like you, who support Hillsdale's mission, we are determined to redouble our efforts at this crucial time for our nation.

That's why we have set a goal to raise $6,000,000 online by December 31 to expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty Through Education** in 2025.

The focus of this vital project is to foster informed patriotism nationwide, especially among younger Americans. And we need your help.

**[Before the end of 2024, would you consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift? We have set a goal to raise $6,000,000 from our friends nationwide by December 31](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b7a036ea30ee40f08976895d8795dab6&_e=wNFDpSDrQw5uROf_EsDGpP4MyP7ffGVBETHLzZyCuI5JOTf-tqF2gw_BFU26irYfpHkZG3ZwHUuHt10md77_dTfm-pTM5M68dj6QRrb2vZ9YQb8tbDTUXgU7Yjs0De3y0AFKoUDv0NsslPSugnNeWvO3uiBTWVV682FfzAGCzDFdroFVYNQrNj4bEbVAVQhWahxoAi0U4XOTHBgPEH7Z1X_XoN6CdfevHRq8d__3QI1Lvb0W0pS8LuUx1ezS0MqKBPO7yUNPbTb1rjvcFRs_stVAWaWSGP_-ee4ovYwn3Lm_uictfm0oriTY6sR839G22_9PvH7Mt63iwOhd-ITL1EpQ9twUbPx_GSI2IJFPovdxJOo-WG9rrcz6xE3qzkGBeOuhC3KIWbpIwsQVgRGMCg%3D%3D).**

Hillsdale's educational outreach on behalf of liberty has never been more urgent than it is today. That's because efforts to undermine patriotism and destroy the American way of life have been increasing--with the ultimate goal of transforming American government and society.

Your year-end gift will help us to promote informed patriotism by educating millions of Americans--especially younger Americans--about our nation's great heritage of liberty.

One way we accomplish this is through our free online courses--courses such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "Land of Hope: The Great American Story," and "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

**We must increase the number of citizens we reach and teach through these free online courses, as well as through our several other educational outreach efforts --efforts such as _Imprimis_ and our ongoing work to help launch and support Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 charter schools nationwide. **

**Defeating the anti-American Left on the battlefield of education is an essential part of reviving and preserving the American way of life.**

Hillsdale College refuses to accept even one penny of government support--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. _This principled independence frees us from many burdensome and corrupting federal regulations and allows us to remain true to our mission._

It also means that we depend entirely on the support of citizens like you.

**I see the tremendous impact of this support as I travel around the nation and talk to those who benefit from Hillsdale 's educational outreach. It is especially gratifying to see the impact on younger Americans.**

Your year-end contribution will help us expand Hillsdale's educational outreach on behalf of liberty in 2025.

If you agree that it is vitally important to promote informed patriotism by educating increasing millions of citizens (especially younger Americans) about our nation's great heritage of liberty, please make your best tax-deductible gift to Hillsdale College by December 31.

**You can give your year-end tax-deductible gift using this secure link:**

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b7a036ea30ee40f08976895d8795dab6&_e=wNFDpSDrQw5uROf_EsDGpP4MyP7ffGVBETHLzZyCuI5JOTf-tqF2gw_BFU26irYfpHkZG3ZwHUuHt10md77_dTfm-pTM5M68dj6QRrb2vZ9YQb8tbDTUXgU7Yjs0De3y0AFKoUDv0NsslPSugnNeWvO3uiBTWVV682FfzAGCzDFdroFVYNQrNj4bEbVAVQhWahxoAi0U4XOTHBgPEH7Z1X_XoN6CdfevHRq8d__3QI24BV4VCjZWJF0fwPxTmP-c7eB28ZIqICMmx46z_F2ozxrDEE25NVeDrdRaN8sumRT7kFs4zPMmGHXHaKcDL6_CDel1DzJyeCVl8NcA3QvplbzpnDzg-lRuINHEBhL3rSNJPvbk6dhkWfj_wiPBVZ6X4w_BuaFRyZrSKhPHHlntvg%3D%3D)

We are honored by your partnership in the crucial year ahead.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
[

Unsubscribe](http://links.bestamericanow.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_s=b7a036ea30ee40f08976895d8795dab6&_t=N_4qAE839QcV2V7z7rH8FVgU2CVxwS8o5LFVUbbU-Fs2F2ixSN539P0Yca4xtl_hJ3YU6nBvTvhfkYVbmGRwO9X9cU5yP0V3oOSSJMwlt65_j87NEaJWOPKT77ND0qtW)

Jason Crow For Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/logoJC%20(1).png]
Hi there, serving in the United States military was one of the greatest honors of my life. I’ve never forgotten the creed I lived by when I served as an Army Ranger:

“My country expects me to move further, faster, and fight harder than any other.”
“I will shoulder more than my share of the task, whatever it may be, 100% and then some.”
“Under no circumstances will I ever embarrass my country.”

After 9/11, I served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan with the Army Rangers.

My three tours taught me a lot about respect, working under pressure, and the value of selfless service to others.

As a leader, it was on me to set an example — to be the last one to eat, and the first one to jump out of the plane.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-december-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-december-2024]

This week, as I make a renewed commitment to standing for our country’s principles and our shared democratic values in the 119th Congress, I’m remembering The Ranger Creed.

I joined the military to protect our rights and freedoms. I ran for office to make a difference in people’s lives. We need more leaders who are ready to do the hard work and bring people together.

I’m ready to get back to work in Congress to make life better for Americans and protect our rights, but I can’t do it alone. subject: 24 Best Questions I Was Asked In 2024...
body:
In 2024, I did several LIVE Q&A;'s where I answered hundreds of questions. I decided for the final Sunday of 2024 to answer 24 of the best questions I
| | [](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10055.1.f42fbdf9f6d9e2adb044931bcc676350) |
---
In 2024, I did several **LIVE Q &A's** where I answered hundreds of questions. I decided for the final Sunday of 2024 to answer 24 of the best questions I was asked. Here is the link to watch and below are the questions: [https://www.youtube.com/live/Syc42Ai4oEo?si=exCQU-2zFuraouWd](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10056.1.f966c3243f8dab3757e437001796c963) [24 BEST QUESTIONS OF 2024:](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10057.1.9f8dbae4ea73ee6ca904dc1dd89fc815) **1\. “How do we treat a family member who is a believer that is struggling with homosexuality?”**
\- Melissa | Tulsa, OK **2\. “Are you predestination or free will?”**
\- Jason, Lansing, Michigan **3\. “Does Satan know our purpose?”**
\- Anonymous **4\. “Is Oprah Winfrey the Antichrist?”**
\- Jennifer | Owasso, OK **5\. “Is the earth flat?”**
\- Jennifer | Owasso, OK **6\. “How can someone know they've received the Holy Spirit? Many say evidenced by the gift of tongues?”**
\- Michelle | Springfield, Illinois **7\. “Do you believe we each have a Guardian Angel?”**
\- Anonymous **8\. “Is there a spiritual aspect to smoking marijuana?”**
\- Anonymous **9\. “What guidance do you give when we listen to online prophets or online pastors?”**
\- Christopher | Mifflinburg, PA **10\. “I know Pastor Jackson uses the NIV, but is there is another Bible that he uses, which version do you recommend?”**
\- Lisa | Fairbanks, WA **11\. “Do you have to be baptized to make it to heaven?”**
\- Jerri | Bend, OR **12\. “I was baptized as a young girl, do I need to be baptized as an adult?”**
\- Hope | Tulsa, OK **13\. “‘Like in the days of Noah’ are we going to see Nephilim (giants) as in the days of old like they did after the flood, before Our Lord Jesus returns?”**
\- Amy | Broken Arrow, OK **14\. “What is your take on the U.S. role in the end times. You hear about other countries in Revelation. Where is the U.S. during all this?”**
\- Taylor | Tulsa, OK **15\. “Are generational curses real for Christians and can a Christian have a demon?”**
\- Anonymous **16\. “Can a woman be in ministry?”**
\- Anonymous **17\. “When do you think the rapture is coming?”**
\- Hannah | Owasso, OK **18\. “Will Christians see the Antichrist or will the rapture occur before then?”**
\- Rhiannon | Tulsa, OK **19\. “What is your favorite book (other than the Bible) and who is your favorite author?”**
\- Anonymous **20\. “Will ones pets go to heaven as well?”**
Allen | Tulsa, OK **21\. “Does sexual intercourse equate to marriage scripturally? What's the difference between a concubine and a wife?”**
\- Cathy | Tulsa, OK **22\. “Who is your goat? Michael Jordan or LeBron James?”**
\- Stephen | Tulsa, OK **23\. “Pastor Jackson, do you speak in tongues? Is it wrong for me to speak in tongues during worship?”**
\- Nancy | Tulsa, OK **24\. “How can I lead people to salvation without causing them to turn further away from Jesus Christ?”**
-Anna | South Dakota These were fun to answer! Also, _please consider_ making an **end of the year donation** to [Sheridan](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10058.1.05ee01d8a9a9542881d6f232db2d2a70) by visiting [www.sheridan.church/give](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10059.1.9fa46355e5ac0c02dd2ff9a8d40eb145)
(_all donations are tax deductible_) **Upcoming Events At Sheridan.Church In 2025:** -Sun, Jan 12 @10am: **Erick Stakelbeck** -Wed, Feb 26 @7pm: **Rabbi Jonathan Cahn** -Thur, Mar 6 @6:30pm: **Eric Trump** | RSVP: [https://www.tickettailor.com/events/sheridanchurch/1493676 ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10060.1.8a23093eb1dff1ab8b97efccf63be34f) Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer
---
| | [ Make An "END OF THE YEAR DONATION" To Sheridan.Church ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10061.1.a0a8700817c92bcdf0efedc18f599b89)
---
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10062.1.2af87d85701c22857d68c967c90fcf44)
---
You are invited to come _meet_ and _hear_ from [Eric Trump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10063.1.1a19c7bbc060388bdce4c67e1f8b7a91) on Thursday, March 6 at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10064.1.4664a51b6161951954c215bf3d8d42ea) in Tulsa, OK. In October, we had **Eric** at **Sheridan** and it was an incredible event. You can watch it here: [https://www.youtube.com/livetrump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10065.1.bfb1b10cb39d99a5fa64f283269ccb5d) However, this March will be even better because **President Trump** will already be in the **White House** and we will hear _exclusive insights_ from **Eric** of what is taking place in the **Trump administration**. There will also be other guests at this event that we will announce as we get closer. Seating is **VERY** limited for this event. Please [RSVP](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10066.1.56c27e6f520211de80fb5cbcd2fdf0f4) here: [https://www.tickettailor.com/events/sheridanchurch/1493676](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10067.1.2394b4ccb3a6f8b456f50271c612c5bd) Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer
---
| | [ RSVP: Eric Trump | Tulsa, OK ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10068.1.1402a423a20105cd61ef4c1099f64a65)
---
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10069.1.65b4fbfef1b44846f073383e5b6fe7c5)
---
Recently at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10070.1.ad41bc2051c2805b7937e2383314b0da), I started a _mini-series_ within our _WKND series_ over the [Book of Acts](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10071.1.c92d5bb1c7e8a09ffd7a782ea1133c3e). In **Acts 17** , the **Apostle Paul** spent 3 weeks in Thessalonica **reasoning** , **explaining** and **proving** **Jesus** from the Old Testament Scriptures. Therefore, I took the **Book of Genesis** and _reasoned_ , _explained_ and _proved_ **Jesus as Messiah** from those 50 chapters in the 1st book of the Bible. The next Sunday, we looked at Jesus in the **Book of Exodus**. I believe these sermons will really teach you some things that maybe you have never seen before from the _*Torah_. Watch "[Jesus In The Torah | Genesis](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10072.1.9b652bf8b1870401c4180201f45fb14f)" here: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=634OIj06ZbU](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10073.1.22e697382be3cf9181dc8b621070e5d4)
---
---
## 1st Guest Speaker of 2025 @Sheridan.Church
---
|
---
Over the last year at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10074.1.18c7bfee2b3ffbf37f6542299e0ed217), we have been BLESSED with so many great guest speakers from preachers to politicians to athletes and beyond. Including: [Perry Stone](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10075.1.f1d05c5d65d4012a092051a83dc24ec7), **Tim Tebow** , [Donald Trump Jr](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10076.1.bbfac03ff37eb147807159777b2c89f7)., [Eric Trump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10077.1.d31f8ff02b0d247e2ddfb427246a2737), [Lara Trump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10078.1.5832a813ed52503e7897dbccc30bc87b), [Rabbi Jonathan Cahn](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10079.1.b7ef9d6849a6ba3fed64acd5d9ee4649), [Darryl Strawberry](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10080.1.64ee9f8e09bdadfb0107eda15d03a4bf), **General Michael Flynn** , [Riley Gaines](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10081.1.a901114f03a768dea2cd14cd21aa8287), [Mayor Rudy Giuliani](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10082.1.e6312abf965a3a7b238ea4ade043d013), [Dr. Randy Caldwell](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10083.1.1693ace652e6b85a7b81dc9fb1367d74), [Roger Stone](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10084.1.c7444b253d09cc26690260750f8d3bad), Rodney Howard-Browne and so many others...
But our first guest speaker of 2025, I am very excited about!
Mark your calendars for **Erick Stakelbeck** at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18580104.10085.1.67b0c05108144c2da414258463e478e7) on Sunday, January 12 at 10am CT.
Erick's show on **TBN** is _phenomenal_ and that Sunday in January will be just as great!

name: Kerry McQuisten (Newsletter)
subject: 2025: Transition and Inauguration!
body:
| | | | |
# The inauguration is just around the bend...
---
| |
---
| America's political scene is currently consumed by two things: the transition and the inauguration celebration. This time, neither process has been done the same way as in recent memory.
The transition team handles what is essentially the country's biggest mass hiring. When a new president is voted in, he brings with him the ability to appoint/hire the _thousands _of individuals who make up his administration. The vast majority of these hired positions are staff jobs you can apply for like any other, and the interview travel and moving expenses to D.C. are on you! Most appointments from Trump himself go through Senate confirmation, though some don't.
Solomon and I are getting _many _calls per week about the inauguration. Some of the bundlers and staff for the finance arm of the campaign committee, the T47C, shifted over to the nonprofit organization that plans the inauguration. The focus is largely on selling the seated tickets, and demand is high. President Trump is expected to raise double to triple the amount Biden raised during his inauguration. Expect to drop six figures for a ticket package! Not even kidding a little. These packages come with tickets to Trump's black-tie Starlight Ball where he and his family will be much of the evening, and other private events depending upon the donation level. There is a reception with the cabinet members, a candlelight dinner with Melania for a mere $500,000, a private prayer service ...
The main attraction is simply the swearing-in ceremony followed by the parade. The entire perimeter will be geofenced - which means once attendees walk in, they will have no cell service. Tickets are divided between multiple security entry points, which open at 6:30 a.m. I hear. Music (and maybe a speaker) starts around 11:30 a.m. It will be _cold _that week. Very cold. Layer up.
Some groups of free tickets were set aside early on - such as the bunch for the 168 RNC members and their plus-ones. Most RNC members pay their own travel, hotel, etc. and are not reimbursed by their state parties - this includes RNC meeting attendance and special events like the inauguration. Oregon is a recent exception with many travel expenses now coming out of donor monies. (Source: FEC.) Packages like the RNC package come with tickets to one of the balls - the Liberty Ball, I believe, and the President will make an appearance there as well.
U.S. Reps and Senators were each given a few hundred tickets on average, which will be given to their constituents via a lottery selection. These tickets are free and the drawing date is set by each office. Those drawings will be held at soon if they haven't already.
We had been told invitations to delegates and groups that attended the convention in Milwaukee would probably go out as they have in the past - or not! I have no answers there. We were hoping to have extra tickets set aside for a couple of the nonprofits for which we volunteer, but it's not looking good!
Balls. These are divided into two kinds: sanctioned and unsanctioned.
Trump held three _sanctioned _balls in 2017; these are the only balls he, his family and the vice president attend. The Starlight and Liberty are both sanctioned this time. The Freedom Ball in 2017 was opened up to the public for $50 tickets on the low end. 8,000 people attended that one! Such arrangements, including the number of sanctioned 2025 balls, have not yet been announced.
There are a number of _unsanctioned _balls; these are also large black-tie affairs that have been established for years. These balls benefit state societies, large veterans or military organizations, etc. You'll probably see some elected officials and celebrities pop in and out of these. They'll be held in some of D.C.'s swankiest venues. Most of these balls are sold out and have been for a while.
Private events that try to pass themselves off as balls. These are _parties _put on by private promoters/sponsors, and the money goes into the promoters' pockets. They usually have a band, a "free" drink, and maybe a hired Z-list celebrity. Guests dress much more casually, and buying tickets is basically the same concept as paying an exorbitant cover charge.
I expect more info to come out this week.
---
| |
---
---
**The Oregon Conservative Caucus!**
---
| We're still growing...!!! Our first goal was to build a solid membership foundation, and we're certainly doing that. Our membership is roughly the same size as the number of delegates in ORP's statewide central committee - we also have more monthly donors and a bank account that's solidly in the black. We're planning our first annual event this coming spring, and have an amazing national keynote speaker lined up. We've also been able to contract with a professional fundraiser with whom we'll meet in D.C. in January. Oh - the IRS notified me we'll be getting our 501(c)4 letter in a couple weeks as well. We're serious about flipping Oregon red. If you want to help us, JOIN!

# Hi Peter, there are only a few days left of 2024! As a valued member of OLCV, I wanted to give you a sneak peak of what’s ahead of us in 2025.
---
[**Peter, we’ve got a lot of work to do in 2025 to protect our climate and environment. Will you help by making a contribution to OLCV today? We can’t do it without you.** ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99533563/520190711/-2029533079?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmYjRlMjEzLWRjYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=elQAL-cwL3iKiz2jWbbwLNDsE-H5_ncIqRUxfW2ZjvE=&emci=30e33e2a-fcbe-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&emdi=0fb4e213-dcc6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=2107230) First, I have to address the elephant in the room. There is undoubtedly a lot of work ahead of us given the results from the federal election. One of the major tasks we know we will face next year is defending our state from climate threats and attempts to backslide on our progress on climate - all things we can’t afford. On top of this, with pro-environment supermajorities in both the Oregon House and Senate, we have a responsibility and a mandate to continue making progress on climate. Here’s an inside look into our priorities for 2025:
* Passing a transportation package that centers climate and equity;
* Advancing solutions for more affordable clean energy, including funding popular climate programs and protecting Oregonians from sky-high rate hikes by holding utility companies accountable;
* Protecting our streamflows and responsibly managing Oregon’s water to ensure a legacy of healthy rivers for everyone and everything that depends on our water.

---
The 2025 legislative session is not far away, so we’re gearing up and equipping our team with everything they need to fight to secure these wins for our climate - stay tuned for more details! There’s so much we can achieve together, but we need your support to get there. [**Will you consider making an end-of-year gift to OLCV today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99533564/520190713/-2029533079?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmYjRlMjEzLWRjYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=elQAL-cwL3iKiz2jWbbwLNDsE-H5_ncIqRUxfW2ZjvE=&emci=30e33e2a-fcbe-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&emdi=0fb4e213-dcc6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=2107230) We’re in a _critical_ time for our state and climate - we all know this - and [**it doesn’t take much to have a large impact in this fight.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/99533567/520190716/-2029533079?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmYjRlMjEzLWRjYzYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTNhZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=elQAL-cwL3iKiz2jWbbwLNDsE-H5_ncIqRUxfW2ZjvE=&emci=30e33e2a-fcbe-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&emdi=0fb4e213-dcc6-ef11-88ce-0022482a93af&ceid=2107230)

clean_body: | | | Dear Peter, In case you missed it, Eliza sent out an inside look into the 2025 legislative session yesterday. Our entire team is preparing for the upcoming session, from recruiting volunteers and building a town hall team, to planning lobby days, to raising the donor dollars it takes to get all this work done. We’ve said it a lot, but it’s true that there’s a lot to be done this next year. By making a donation now, you will help Oregonians who care about this fight connect to our work. It will support our lobby days, building our Town Hall Team, letters to the editor (LTE) and testimony drives, and boost our volunteer engagement through recruitment and training. With thanks, Britney VanCittersOLCV Political & Organizing Director | Hi Peter, there are only a few days left of 2024! As a valued member of OLCV, I wanted to give you a sneak peak of what’s ahead of us in 2025. First, I have to address the elephant in the room. There is undoubtedly a lot of work ahead of us given the results from the federal election. One of the major tasks we know we will face next year is defending our state from climate threats and attempts to backslide on our progress on climate - all things we can’t afford. On top of this, with pro-environment supermajorities in both the Oregon House and Senate, we have a responsibility and a mandate to continue making progress on climate. Here’s an inside look into our priorities for 2025: Passing a transportation package that centers climate and equity; Advancing solutions for more affordable clean energy, including funding popular climate programs and protecting Oregonians from sky-high rate hikes by holding utility companies accountable; Protecting our streamflows and responsibly managing Oregon’s water to ensure a legacy of healthy rivers for everyone and everything that depends on our water. The 2025 legislative session is not far away, so we’re gearing up and equipping our team with everything they need to fight to secure these wins for our climate - stay tuned for more details! There’s so much we can achieve together, but we need your support to get there. We’re in a critical time for our state and climate - we all know this - and | | I’ll be busy in Salem throughout the legislative session talking to our elected officials and fighting for our climate, but I can’t do it alone. Your donation today will fund our efforts to: Hold our elected officials accountable for standing up for our climate this upcoming session Educate Oregonians with timely updates and action alerts during the legislative session, so our elected leaders know how important it is to us that we continue taking action on climate Recruit volunteers to speak directly with elected officials and write testimonials * Protect our state against federal threats on our climate This fight is so much bigger than all of us, which makes your donation all the more important and powerful. name: Hillsdale College via Defend the Constitution
subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a National Referendum on Religious Liberty.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8434e4b13c4c4754a17cbe27eb506f11&_e=S4IanyuGrRLNPyKPwazD9GloS0226pKZylF0pDsUnj2Qvk99FzNX9zu3Zic80eVf1DWD9C_-LQhzYSiJmI9CqqcVDukGo_UeL080_1C6AMORJ9yGL6Wrf6v5aX3rTqvSvsdvDP8I3PjCf79He8ycTDwjULpAdgkEQ8T37zEBXs9gpVt52Rj9RAFQfqPh_TkFetkaS3bAJzpOko4C3Q0j4CZe4axD0GgDjy19x-mRAzLULr7DKL65BsPm26yaWM0NM0JsMke_GxvPho36O_lNgGZadpmqPz40vMDwMzjvg1TP_bIchfpSwG6DvMT8aQNEb8wDgaknKgfwhCqwbkyEV9cc5ocZCQuKQZ0nZyXpFZVkCQ7Gz5FhlRItxeN8Fwkcx52eOm7l8gSl1AcemA37SJ7TWfVu_NH8xJEsqoFropo%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8434e4b13c4c4754a17cbe27eb506f11&_e=S4IanyuGrRLNPyKPwazD9GloS0226pKZylF0pDsUnj2Qvk99FzNX9zu3Zic80eVf1DWD9C_-LQhzYSiJmI9CqqcVDukGo_UeL080_1C6AMORJ9yGL6Wrf6v5aX3rTqvSvsdvDP8I3PjCf79He8ycTDwjULpAdgkEQ8T37zEBXs9gpVt52Rj9RAFQfqPh_TkFetkaS3bAJzpOko4C3Q0j4CZe4axD0GgDjy19x-mRAzLULr7DKL65BsPm26yaWM0N_E-Il623MOIF6o0R43BJygH348oOPSg43xPGqUMGYlTIGG3EWbN06SLUka29yUkC0GWigSLMN9ILWQOHIvBkND5mGp6TxFVKPrIKZa1sIx9lwvN9gxUAYiKYsX1wzWQU2VaYOGlpDL2hifWfzWOnDKX-PQC4Kbd-9iXRLhfYAo8%3D) The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://info.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8434e4b13c4c4754a17cbe27eb506f11&_e=S4IanyuGrRLNPyKPwazD9GloS0226pKZylF0pDsUnj2Qvk99FzNX9zu3Zic80eVf1DWD9C_-LQhzYSiJmI9CqqcVDukGo_UeL080_1C6AMORJ9yGL6Wrf6v5aX3rTqvSvsdvDP8I3PjCf79He8ycTDwjULpAdgkEQ8T37zEBXs9gpVt52Rj9RAFQfqPh_TkFetkaS3bAJzpOko4C3Q0j4CZe4axD0GgDjy19x-mRAzLULr7DKL65BsPm26yaWM0NW1BxcEH7-XEXl6AYX11cSZhLcNYQd6jL6-pUtHONb_VIcjg7OV24mPcz5SIs-YUn85mGLgWlzpeV3Ya10WYRgDvVci3NoMzqh7fs6X8iT_njKi5Uix-xEfBHsKG30Rz81GaisnMj_qo3Tm-DQ50MeVViFJdB4e71lnyl-5vJHLw%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://info.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8434e4b13c4c4754a17cbe27eb506f11&_e=S4IanyuGrRLNPyKPwazD9GloS0226pKZylF0pDsUnj2Qvk99FzNX9zu3Zic80eVf1DWD9C_-LQhzYSiJmI9CqqcVDukGo_UeL080_1C6AMORJ9yGL6Wrf6v5aX3rTqvSvsdvDP8I3PjCf79He8ycTDwjULpAdgkEQ8T37zEBXs9gpVt52Rj9RAFQfqPh_TkFetkaS3bAJzpOko4C3Q0j4CZe4axD0GgDjy19x-mRAzLULr7DKL65BsPm26yaWM0NTYuDaYnnhKeLgrMksyN9W4dKWo6inqFB6nJ2ZtGHOkodCQ1lxLVI-QAiHUKOPHKqbdDEsUxvXzawYWIATe0-O8DHh6lpPVJzh5-qbxjdAiRYwxdyor1jx0sxKvp6oiaUFqUaRP0-XOJrd7DipuBLr9DIgcSTuk0qNt1YCFKGsWs%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a National Referendum on Religious Liberty. The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open. Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation. The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.” Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the National Referendum on Religious Liberty by using the secure link below: Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty." Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. The first step is ...EDUCATION. Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Save Religious Liberty in America. These efforts include: Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country. Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon. Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty. Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies. I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty , which you can access at this secure link: Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 | | Defend the Constitution PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

Our nation is at a crossroads.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=65de09447b4d44bbb59bbdbe34f32a5d&_e=zx3WVcT9UCaV1VNANmhKlaVHnjIzJxJfXMsWcBUQj9NcXSnqbgwI7cnfrDrJQkvicCBNBs31vjrxPC7sZU6b05sIhkrpITTP8S15Kwr57AOTy9e-Hr-8kWGE3O4ela5DfnTv4bGHjPnBNROHLad2Wiaiq2pjnQ5hhlz02jrE8vqzzxEwZAGTVyaoYB-8_tZUU3B0UqGWwbR-0WRc9J-pMZlfW2WLgx4fUjDjkOwEBcjNZKaWTQmyXKIgnrpD95kwgbnoUaYELIZzYYn5SxnPZ-7ZO8tPL_F5bWk09q6nxp57fxkN_9WcRP_ftSjmq9xGvaK29dWOl9TOcwyon9F-eM_9g3UpXZrEGtQ3KIype--bWiW_kTI-CEWijlYVqdVc)

Dear Friend,

Our nation is at a crossroads. Patriotic Americans have an opportunity in 2025 to take fundamental steps in the direction of reviving and preserving liberty and free government.

It is imperative to make the most of this opportunity in order to pass on the blessings of the American way of life to future generations.

As you may know, Hillsdale College is the only educational institution in the country that is in a strong position to reach and teach millions of Americans about America's founding principles and its great heritage of liberty. And we are expanding our efforts to do just that.

To press forward with our educational mission on behalf of liberty during a critical time for America, we have set an ambitious goal to raise $6,000,000 online by December 31 to expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education** in 2025.

[Will you partner with us in defending the cause of liberty and free government nationwide through education with your year-end support and make a generous gift to Hillsdale College today?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=65de09447b4d44bbb59bbdbe34f32a5d&_e=zx3WVcT9UCaV1VNANmhKlaVHnjIzJxJfXMsWcBUQj9NcXSnqbgwI7cnfrDrJQkvicCBNBs31vjrxPC7sZU6b05sIhkrpITTP8S15Kwr57AOTy9e-Hr-8kWGE3O4ela5DfnTv4bGHjPnBNROHLad2Wiaiq2pjnQ5hhlz02jrE8vqzzxEwZAGTVyaoYB-8_tZUU3B0UqGWwbR-0WRc9J-pMZlfW2WLgx4fUjDjkOwEBciegKsN9eyFfHTTCSsung1leWw-SFNRRaneNgbab5ozRG-vpB8iQKEAtii3A6jsKyGZPdUr13Wblr9pF8tmtzfv-pVu3OZMhPLycA-kr44QSxH2kIceJ99-L2dFogHBDZjuQN9BBVCrkWHWmGsVByna)

What all of us do today will have significant consequences for the survival of the American way of life. We have the opportunity to make 2025 a year that future American patriots will look back on with gratitude.

Make no mistake. Powerful forces who seek to undermine our way of life--not only socialist politicians but also the legacy media, the entertainment industry, and Big Tech--will be working tirelessly to undermine liberty and free government, including in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

Indeed, successfully engaging the Left on the battleground of American education is of fundamental importance if we are to revive and preserve liberty for future generations.

But success will require the faithful and generous support of patriotic Americans like you--citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty in a free republic. [That's why we're asking for your year-end support to continue and expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education**.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=65de09447b4d44bbb59bbdbe34f32a5d&_e=zx3WVcT9UCaV1VNANmhKlaVHnjIzJxJfXMsWcBUQj9NcXSnqbgwI7cnfrDrJQkvicCBNBs31vjrxPC7sZU6b05sIhkrpITTP8S15Kwr57AOTy9e-Hr-8kWGE3O4ela5DfnTv4bGHjPnBNROHLad2Wiaiq2pjnQ5hhlz02jrE8vqzzxEwZAGTVyaoYB-8_tZUU3B0UqGWwbR-0WRc9J-pMZlfW2WLgx4fUjDjkOwEBci3_vbpFX2lk-Ir9r-HRgN49vjxNSuxh0Xluh0uOYXRtk0lBo8qjt-eRud47obH4DyOCvAql69ZNF32RU3DlvJHqPdbwYZ6hffmvONxUcdssjtQ0_zqdG29V9K-qM_YzX-lFhc2Fs5z-ztcevCDJqPT)

**We must do all that we possibly can.**

With the help of friends like you, who support Hillsdale's educational mission, we are determined to redouble our efforts at this critical time for our nation.

You will help us to ...

* **Reach an additional 600,000 American households and businesses with _Imprimis_ , our monthly digest of liberty.** With your support, we plan to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to more than 7 million households and businesses in 2025.
* **Teach citizens nationwide, especially younger Americans, through our FREE online courses.** Your donation will help us to create new online courses and add 900,000 new students in 2025.
* **Restore excellence to American K-12 education.** Your faithful generosity will help us to launch and guide increasing numbers of classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Reading and watching the news reminds us every day that our work is far from finished. America remains deeply divided. The gains we've made on behalf of liberty in recent years are fragile.

**With your help, we will succeed --because we must succeed for our country!**

Hillsdale College **conducts its educational outreach efforts** --as it does all its work--while refusing to accept **one penny** of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

To meet our ambitious year-end funding goal, we will need thousands of gifts between **$25** and **$100**. Most of our supporters' contributions are in this range.

We will also need a significant number of **$500** to **$1,000** donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

Since we have less than a month remaining to fund this project for 2025, we urgently need your help.

**You can safely and securely renew your support using this link:[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=65de09447b4d44bbb59bbdbe34f32a5d&_e=zx3WVcT9UCaV1VNANmhKlaVHnjIzJxJfXMsWcBUQj9NcXSnqbgwI7cnfrDrJQkvicCBNBs31vjrxPC7sZU6b05sIhkrpITTP8S15Kwr57AOTy9e-Hr-8kWGE3O4ela5DfnTv4bGHjPnBNROHLad2Wiaiq2pjnQ5hhlz02jrE8vqzzxEwZAGTVyaoYB-8_tZUU3B0UqGWwbR-0WRc9J-pMZlfW2WLgx4fUjDjkOwEBcjH_r-xMDr7K3uv_HtfxO0SqjBz9Ce8UhyZKnVIMgMassk_f_naJkYsgDCN2NYbSfP99bajKJqM0-SkMXqW_2DSl4oLjlZILlG2ZXeCCNF4bfbqxlfisD9JHg0bvofcN3MezHARdfe9FP7i0vDYb_hR)**

It is not an exaggeration to say that the future of American liberty and the American way of life depends on the efforts of patriotic Americans over the next few years.

That's why I hope you'll make your most generous year-end gift to Hillsdale College before the **December 31** deadline.

Every dollar you give will get us closer to our **$6,000,000** online fundraising goal, enabling us to expand our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education**.

Please partner with Hillsdale College to make 2025 a significant turning point in the revival and preservation of the American way of life.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Be Inspired by Bold Believers Get Your Copy Today
For 25 years, Todd Nettleton, the host of VOM Radio, has ventured into some of the world's most hostile and restricted nations.

His mission? To meet the courageous men and women who have faced persecution for their unwavering faith in Christ. Todd has traveled far and wide to hear their powerful stories firsthand and to bring their voices to the world, sharing their extraordinary testimonies of faith and resilience.

In his new book, _When Faith Is Forbidden: 40 Days on the Frontlines with Persecuted Christians_ , Todd invites you to meet these bold believers.

Each stop on this journey will challenge you to reflect on your own walk with Christ along the sometimes-difficult path toward our heavenly home.

Through their incredible stories of courageous faith, we pray you will be inspired to a deeper, bolder walk with Christ.

This compelling book is free for you with any gift--simply request your copy today.

| Dear friends,
Serving as your State Senator is a privilege, and as we welcome the New Year, I hope you and your family enjoyed a joyful and relaxing holiday season. My commitment to representing our community with integrity and dedication remains steadfast. This year, I will continue to keep you well-informed and engaged in the latest developments in Lansing and our district. The New Year brings fresh opportunities to work toward bringing back a Republican Senate majority, and I am excited about what we can accomplish together. Transparency and accountability will remain at the core of my service. Thank you for your ongoing support—it motivates me to work even harder for our community in 2025.
---
|
---
| **Community Investments**
This year, I’m proud to have been able to secure $36 million in community investments for West Michigan, which will have a lasting impact on our region. These investments include:
* $3,000,000 for the West Michigan Sports Commission in Plainfield Township, supporting local recreational development and boosting the economy.
* $1,000,000 for the Van Andel Institute in Grand Rapids, advancing cutting-edge medical research and innovation.
* $1,000,000 for the Krause Memorial Library in the City of Rockford, enhancing educational resources and community access.

These projects reflect my commitment to fostering growth, innovation, and opportunity for the people of West Michigan.
---
|
---
| **Taxpayer Accountability Matters**
I recently sent a letter to Michigan Economic Development Corp. CEO Quentin Messer urging him to provide answers about $666.1 million in incentives previously awarded to General Motors now that the company has announced its plan to sell its investment stake in the Ultium Cells Battery Plant.

GM lobbied both the MEDC and the Legislature to receive Strategic Outreach and Reserve Fund incentives under the premise that it was committed to creating jobs and investment in Michigan, but GM’s recent announcement contradicts that premise.

Hardworking Michigan taxpayers deserve answers and expect proper oversight to ensure taxpayer dollars are being used responsibly to improve our state and grow our economy. We’re talking about hundreds and hundreds of millions of dollars, and the people have a right to full transparency in how their tax dollars are being spent.

My letter asked several questions, including:▪ Did a contract exist between the MEDC and GM or its involved entities? If so, did it include any clawback provisions?▪ Was the MEDC made aware of GM’s intentions to sell off its majority stake prior to its public announcement? And if yes, were any disbursements made to the company after learning of this sale?▪ Does the MEDC intend to change its vetting process when working with corporations going forward to ensure commitments to Michigan taxpayers are upheld?
When my colleagues and I voted to create SOAR and its respective funds, a central priority of ours was creating accountability mechanisms for recipients of these grants. Clawback provisions, requisite benchmarks for job creation and return on investment, and legislative oversight were all bedrock elements of the program’s creation.
---
|
---
| **Thank you!**
Your efforts are truly impactful. By contributing, you’re helping us advocate for the changes and reforms our community needs. Every donation, no matter the size, fuels our mission and ensures a brighter future for all. Join us in shaping a better tomorrow; donate today!

name: Riley Gaines
subject: WHY Women’s Rights Are Under Attack
body:
This is our opportunity
| Friend, Donald Trump’s victory brings renewed hope for conservative values. A renewed chance to set things right.
But the work is far from over. As a matter of fact, **it's just begun.** The radical left is determined to undermine women’s rights, and they still hold power all over our country, especially on college campuses. Consider this -- in recent years, males competing against women has led to female athletes who have lost out on opportunities, been exploited in changing rooms, and suffered injuries from male athletes posing as women on the opposing team. This isn't just an issue of wins and losses -- it’s about **respect** , **opportunity** , and **equality**. Now, consider this -- there is an entire political movement dedicated to cramming men into locker rooms with our daughters. Just sit with that for a second.
It is crucial that you and I stand firm against the forces that threaten our hard-fought gains. Women’s sports and opportunities are at risk, and must be protected.
At the Riley Gaines Center, **_my ambassadors and I are taking action_** to educate the public, advocate for women’s rights, and build a community of supporters. I’m asking for your help to expand our initiatives and reach even more individuals who share this vision.
Before the end of the year, I need to raise $300,000 to fully fund our Ambassador program. We've got to let you know, Team, that a bill that would give President-elect Donald Trump broad powers to target his political foes has passed a major hurdle toward becoming law, recently passing in the U.S. House of Representatives.
The bill, also known as H.R. 9495, would empower the Treasury secretary to unilaterally designate any nonprofit as a “terrorist supporting organization” and revoke its tax-exempt status, effectively killing the group. The bill could give presidential administrations a tool to crack down on organizations for political reasons.
“ Authoritarianism is not born overnight — it creeps in ,” Rep. Lloyd Doggett said on the House floor. “ A tyrant tightens his grip not just by seizing power, but when he demands new powers and when those who can stop him willingly cede and bend to his will .” “ A sixth grader would know this is unconstitutional ,” added Rep. Jamie Raskin.
Unconstitutional and authoritarian or not, this bill has passed the House now and has a good chance of passing both houses of Congress next year. That's why we need to start working now to prevent this bill from ever becoming law.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. body:
My final chance to save my home...

They want “SEVERE” sanctions against me.
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f0affcf55fe94852826bc979c1b704eb&_e=pxuu2RF9DHmqFIRRaxGX5YWWgmiQ-iaoDFnurEJRE-hbz0jQ-FoSXSHiGzio_zzbLHvnySaQZZHq6Qu57UlqYug2t3Z95QZdldycQYXU6GTTdDb9sIcFb_XEeVBgFKtEBvLjLZTdQeuyHgcJ1HRb4uYcnjG3QQ64vcSr7mwspsfCx5kbT_Y1REmKPc26mCZ7m62peAlTLoIfhYYUw5a4dxlHTcK8G-kpfRzDPC3FgE1qMhPSbb05uNc3VqhrFzm5q7TMnGPxVHdhoqatP59T9N6cWv6JUE-YPWAETuTEB2HVqi8r9EZ5cOV32Uqos7VP2AOJz-uJhix9JnKvVJSxxGkHLnPb270HznIV-uOvjGE7AHDC0QcDJWPweCFuEoOuFruhZU7-669djc1WZxBw3g%3D%3D)
---
Dear Friend,
---
I didn’t want to bother you over the Christmas holiday, but I now have something very important to share with you.
---
Reports indicate that my trial is set to begin on January 16 – just days before President Trump’s inauguration.
---
**_This trial will determine whether the Left can seize my home in Florida and truly leave me with NOTHING. This is my _final_ chance to save my home._**
---
Since there’s no way I can pay the outrageous $148 MILLION judgment against me, they want to rob me of everything I own.
---
They want irreplaceable mementos I gave to my only son. They want personal gifts that I was given by allies abroad to show solidarity with America after the tragedy of September 11th.
---
During these difficult times, Christmas reminded me of what’s _truly_ important in life. Earthly possessions come and go – homes, cars, money all come to an end. But the Bible reminds us that _eternal_ “heavenly treasures” await us.
---
The pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to my possessions.**
---
_"_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_
---

clean_body: My final chance to save my home... They want “SEVERE” sanctions against me. | Dear Friend, I didn’t want to bother you over the Christmas holiday, but I now have something very important to share with you. Reports indicate that my trial is set to begin on January 16 – just days before President Trump’s inauguration. This trial will determine whether the Left can seize my home in Florida and truly leave me with NOTHING. This is my final chance to save my home. Since there’s no way I can pay the outrageous $148 MILLION judgment against me, they want to rob me of everything I own. They want irreplaceable mementos I gave to my only son. They want personal gifts that I was given by allies abroad to show solidarity with America after the tragedy of September 11th. During these difficult times, Christmas reminded me of what’s truly important in life. Earthly possessions come and go – homes, cars, money all come to an end. But the Bible reminds us that eternal “heavenly treasures” await us. The pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession. I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to my possessions. "For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? " (Mark 8:36) As I prepare for my January trial, I’m asking patriots like you to make a contribution to my Legal Defense Trust so that I can keep fighting for my freedom and justice against a rigged and weaponized legal system. Thank you and God bless you, Rudy Giuliani Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Paid for by Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Legal Defense Trust Conservatives Give PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

name: Wes Moore
subject: My 2024 highlights
body:
Friend, 2024 was a marathon, not a sprint. We accomplished so much, and I wanted to take a moment to reflect upon some of the top hits.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]

Sixteen Bills

During this year’s legislative session, we shipped over a package of 16 bills to accomplish four goals to move Maryland forward. These goals set out to make Maryland:

➡️ Safer
➡️ More Affordable
➡️ More Competitive
➡️ The State that Serves

We’re proud of the bi-partisan efforts to ensure all 16 of these bills passed through the legislature and I proudly signed these bills into law.

State of the State

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]

At the beginning of February, I gave the State of the State Address to reflect on the successes of 2023, and set forth goals for 2024 that would continue setting Maryland up for success. One thing we took away from that moment is that our state is strong .

This year, I announced the first state plan in a decade. My administration laid out its vision and strategies to accomplish ten priorities. We can set up specific metrics to track our progress with these targets. We’re expecting to announce key performance updates in 2025 — and we’re looking forward to sharing just how much progress we’ve been able to accomplish since announcing the State Plan.

Pardoning 175,000 convictions in Maryland

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]

In June, I signed the largest pardon in the country — making history in our great state. I signed an executive order pardoning 175,000 convictions related to the possession of cannabis. This is a huge milestone for Maryland after the legalization of cannabis in 2023.

Getting Out the Vote

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]

In Maryland and across the country, my team and I spent countless hours traveling to ensure that every single voter cast their ballot in the 2024 election. While we didn’t get the results we were looking for, we got great turnout and met some special people along the way.

Wins in Maryland

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]

We made history here in Maryland electing Angela Alsobrooks as our Senator, the first Black Senator elected in our state. We also elected several members to the House of Representatives who will continue to fight to make this Maryland’s decade.

Onto the New Year

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]

Now we’re winding down before the new year kicks into full swing. I’m excited to get down to work and see what else there is in store to continue making this Maryland’s decade.

That’s a wrap!

Elevate,

Wes

P.S. We have an important December goal we need to hit by tomorrow at midnight. Can you make a donation toward our goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]
Contribute » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1]

Friend, We are just 21 days from the 60th Presidential Inauguration in Washington, DC.
That means we are 21 days away from entering the Golden Age of the United States of America--just 21 days away from Making America Safe, Prosperous, Affordable, and Great Again!
During the 2024 Campaign Season, the RNC Youth Advisory Council was instrumental in securing President Trump's victory. We secured over 46% of the youth vote, a 10% increase over the 2020 election.
Working with my colleagues on the Youth Council, we were successful in the herculean effort to win over our generation at the ballot box.
As a thank you for our hard work, my friends, Brilyn Hollyhand, Riley Gaines, and I, and many others on the council, will all be in attendance at the 60th Presidential Inauguration in just 21 days.
As we gear up to celebrate our nation's return to greatness, I would like your help making the journey to DC possible.
I do not come from a political pedigree, dynasty, or money, which makes traveling to such occasions difficult at the age of 21, especially when I have been volunteering my time to these efforts.
Will you help me make the journey to the most historic inauguration of our lifetimes possible?

Sign if you agree: It’s time to bring reform to Washington and enact term limits in Congress. body:
