# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/99539971/520208922/-488448398?refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20241230_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOTIzMWY5Yi1lOWM2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDIyNDgyYTkzYWYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uMoAKz2aUuTQwt7M9SHgvvLb5MIsXvdfH5kpbWc7Vfw=)
---
Peter, In case you missed it, Donald Trump is letting Elon Musk use our government as his personal playground. Let me catch you up: Right before the holidays, Speaker Mike Johnson put together a continuing resolution (CR) to keep the government funded until March. subject: You haven’t given up on our nation
body:
_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3ff8e3a76f3741bba3244dc71af955e3&_e=egl8cacTd5aEMQ8fVR0mZD3ltYpjYmCDSTNMsK8EA3g6cj5EE9eleNhypZ699QeZyyKbPNtAdHQUcOkg119RUlmAbermqamvVAgfM6lXzDYNgXQTu_QU0nJLorJMC0Fi5Ww7IDC4nwua8G11Ky94_BZzFIfg0BHMI9qLBYlV2k6wkoyAWRS45LpkbwI5VFbEMTJmGgk-Q-BDoli8V9BMpObR_gAtoU1k9i60SuntOf0-fP6xmsKjOstJfxt5hV2ShQr6bSSvEhiQnrQfKAkaTOBFeNMNIW_81fCbz8_HTgHQgOg9xeuNT6RsqdVn5pU0g2yTsRsuVGxPPRsWFNJ5EOLs6hx0UrB16Wyb6L2pJLjKWBXboF-OidqrfRy2Bd7VSOWGlHwycDve4ulREjtg8A%3D%3D)
---
| |
Dear Friend,

It's cold and quiet in Hillsdale, Michigan today. I hope you're staying warm, and that you and your family are doing well. Our students have headed home for a much-needed break, and I wanted to send you a quick note as we approach the close of 2024.

The end of one year and the beginning of another is a natural time to reflect. When I think back over the year that was, I never could've predicted we'd be where we are today. Did you think we'd see...

Campus protests, legacy media censorship, wars in Europe and the Middle East, and multiple assassination attempts of a presidential candidate?

I certainly didn't!

At the same time...

This year ended with so many Americans showing they haven't given up on this country. A renewed hope is in the air. There is a feeling that we can and will accomplish great things again.

I don't know about you, but when I remember America and its leaders in my prayers, I am so grateful to God to live in a country where the people can still choose those leaders and where we can enjoy so much personal freedom.

Even with the events of the last few years, our country remains "the last, best hope on earth," to quote one of our country's greatest presidents--Abraham Lincoln.

Like America in Lincoln's time, our country is once again going through a time of crisis and division. That's why next year if we're going to restore liberty, we must educate all who wish to learn. [We must make it possible for them to do so for FREE if it is within our power.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3ff8e3a76f3741bba3244dc71af955e3&_e=egl8cacTd5aEMQ8fVR0mZD3ltYpjYmCDSTNMsK8EA3g6cj5EE9eleNhypZ699QeZyyKbPNtAdHQUcOkg119RUlmAbermqamvVAgfM6lXzDYNgXQTu_QU0nJLorJMC0Fi5Ww7IDC4nwua8G11Ky94_BZzFIfg0BHMI9qLBYlV2k6wkoyAWRS45LpkbwI5VFbEMTJmGgk-Q-BDoli8V9BMpObR_gAtoU1k9i60SuntOf3n7inVLptdpwDhgkWrdoFSe_PAxl4GaL6tEwQfqVD2GTMIwgMiKTbj1W4HsulXiEYuEAXWkOEuFb46xLzZXoHXEgZdLiVsjNUP_CW4vIP0h0Qobw67g-90bOCiSg8z2_nxidYGRp59qqzGfe9XlYRNZVz5ZYCrBS0jAQsPsv8vaQ%3D%3D)

And that means that you and I must do all we can to teach the next generation the principles of liberty, something that Hillsdale does better than any other college in America.

We're committed to doing this no matter the cost because it's part of our 180-year-old mission to preserve "the blessings of liberty" we enjoy in America.

Our extensive **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education** is one of the most effective ways to engage the far-Left on the battlefield of education.

Through _Imprimis_ , free online courses, the Hillsdale College Podcast Network, and classical K-12 educational outreach, we are "developing minds and improving hearts," one community, one school, one classroom, one student at a time.

And this is multiplied by thousands and thousands...

If possible, could you consider making a generous tax-deductible gift before December 31? Hillsdale's mission is so important, and I know you stand with us. Your timely donation will help us continue to expand these programs in this **critical time for our nation while helping us reach our ambitious year-end fundraising goal.**

**If you 're able, please make your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $100, or even $250 before midnight on December 31. **

**We still have not reached our $6,000,000 goal, and time is running out.**

I've included a secure link for you to see our progress and to make your gift safely:

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3ff8e3a76f3741bba3244dc71af955e3&_e=egl8cacTd5aEMQ8fVR0mZD3ltYpjYmCDSTNMsK8EA3g6cj5EE9eleNhypZ699QeZyyKbPNtAdHQUcOkg119RUlmAbermqamvVAgfM6lXzDYNgXQTu_QU0nJLorJMC0Fi5Ww7IDC4nwua8G11Ky94_BZzFIfg0BHMI9qLBYlV2k6wkoyAWRS45LpkbwI5VFbEMTJmGgk-Q-BDoli8V9BMpObR_gAtoU1k9i60SuntOf0dksEAHY1NNhfZWz51B_wPM8As7iv0xzf1qXSJYUWbIi62oa7y0xJ99yLdiFefRjkpYpmlzTE0VECgVVMnx5CfIQ1EE1AqA9Y1zw08mVo5q9k-OKOm1A4adeDfU26FT9GoTQ1g4PgELhtXp27crlOS16qLGNp-xYTZBZYjD2LaHg%3D%3D)

Please know how thankful I am to have you as a friend. Together, we can educate for liberty in America. Enjoy the rest of your day!

Looking forward to hearing from you,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. There's more that we have to do to secure liberty in America in 2025. That's why we have an ambitious $6,000,000 online fundraising goal. So, would you be willing to make a gift to help reach and teach even more people? Here's a secure link for you to chip in a $50, $100, or even $250 gift:

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye2024](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3ff8e3a76f3741bba3244dc71af955e3&_e=egl8cacTd5aEMQ8fVR0mZD3ltYpjYmCDSTNMsK8EA3g6cj5EE9eleNhypZ699QeZyyKbPNtAdHQUcOkg119RUlmAbermqamvVAgfM6lXzDYNgXQTu_QU0nJLorJMC0Fi5Ww7IDC4nwua8G11Ky94_BZzFIfg0BHMI9qLBYlV2k6wkoyAWRS45LpkbwI5VFbEMTJmGgk-Q-BDoli8V9BMpObR_gAtoU1k9i60SuntOf0dsNAumeXCSfptcy4AxVYcsh9D8SbcaJaVg6XCLvvu6ZXS-PjkL9IcBpCO1P8UnuWc1WO2wRbN_rfgBT8L8BO3HYf7Mibjjpolvi7RIJ1X-AfSzYMPCzaVKunNqYQtakEKR9_MeBwSOdxV9ggaQn9XW4uiydN3MezORnTZg-mSFw%3D%3D)

Thank you!

[Unsubscribe](http://links.g4yamerica.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_s=3ff8e3a76f3741bba3244dc71af955e3&_t=PeUGXseQdCaHmRTqwBa_08VSO0Ga77E61Y3pgyBBZCzRkXRwudFt9QVQg_d6UALp4S4VnuurOlhNbBWIoBLv3o71tvGQQT0qmyp7rh94Ed3VTmdM88rTsbyON99Foi0s)

name: Benson HQ
subject: You spoke. We listened.

body:
Ready to hear what people are saying?
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/5?t=1&akid=16%2E181023%2EZtqdqk)
Recently, we asked to hear what your hopes and concerns are for 2025, and what you took away from this year’s election. Ready to hear what people are saying?
Many of you praised Secretary Benson’s tireless work to make our elections safe, smooth, and secure. Thank you!
_"It was very easy to vote. I had no concerns about security.”_
_“I felt the election process for the 2024 General Election was excellent. Loved the early voting option. Well done!”_
_“Secretary Benson is a rock star! MDOS is awesome as is BOE. Thank you for meeting the high standards and setting the bar high for voters.”_

But a lot of folks are worried about what’s next for our democracy at large:
_“I am extremely worried about the next four years especially in the realms of civil rights and the rule of law.”_

We hear you. Nobody knows exactly what the next administration has in store for us, or what new threats we may face to the integrity of our elections and institutions.
If you’re one of the people who’s worrying, know this: **Michigan’s Secretary of State has dedicated her entire life to defending democracy.** Jocelyn Benson is prepared for any challenges thrown our way -- in 2025 and beyond.
**[We can’t let fear win. We have to fight. If you’re ready to play a part in defending democracy in Michigan, please chip in $5 or whatever you can.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jb-em-20241230-1?refcode=em20241230-1&refcode2=16_181023_Ztqdqk&akid=16%2E181023%2EZtqdqk)**
**[Contribute $5 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jb-em-20241230-1?amount=5&refcode=em20241230-1&refcode2=16_181023_Ztqdqk&akid=16%2E181023%2EZtqdqk)**
_“Democracy is worth fighting for. It's not about winning every fight but about preserving this amazing set of legal, judicial and electoral processes, for all citizens.”_

We’re in this together. Thank you and we look forward to hearing more from you all.
-- Benson HQ

clean_body: Ready to hear what people are saying? Recently, we asked to hear what your hopes and concerns are for 2025, and what you took away from this year’s election. Ready to hear what people are saying? Many of you praised Secretary Benson’s tireless work to make our elections safe, smooth, and secure. Thank you! "It was very easy to vote. I had no concerns about security.” “I felt the election process for the 2024 General Election was excellent. Loved the early voting option. Well done!” “Secretary Benson is a rock star! MDOS is awesome as is BOE. Thank you for meeting the high standards and setting the bar high for voters.” But a lot of folks are worried about what’s next for our democracy at large: “I am extremely worried about the next four years especially in the realms of civil rights and the rule of law.” We hear you. Nobody knows exactly what the next administration has in store for us, or what new threats we may face to the integrity of our elections and institutions. If you’re one of the people who’s worrying, know this: Michigan’s Secretary of State has dedicated her entire life to defending democracy. Jocelyn Benson is prepared for any challenges thrown our way -- in 2025 and beyond. “Democracy is worth fighting for. It's not about winning every fight but about preserving this amazing set of legal, judicial and electoral processes, for all citizens.” We’re in this together. Thank you and we look forward to hearing more from you all. -- Benson HQ

He always dreamed of following in his dad's footsteps to be a police officer. I also included one of my favorites of us from the night he graduated from the Police Academy.I was so proud that night.Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder --** murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.****[**I'm praying you will help me save my son**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=a2a1944b7f2741b5a4e022edbbd2d1e6&_e=uvmziv1Ls6cYVY1pREljV30EevWAABlSWpE3FeIQEL7JWrKPxKSVw29wYFpz6PjLUMQFOJhy5pZEXuFWUtg_lExZKB7D7INEpd3wjbIBKwrjDBnlSG_YG3XGEWI3pYnxKjrHkj1_-2ewoK5ADCs-gtFOCqWcI6iNDH9IA3Lud1uEmePJPK7TxdHrx4Wex8cNKuB48rmiV5FjYDt00p6t8Y4xtiZYNAgoshwxI8ptk6pIG4U6CgN07b7yoTVpjsGNS-XeWajk_VFraQGnZDd5GhMCTGvf04r-i6hj0-CEb7gVFzzN9cM5J9pQ3l9ZVh5thg3sBcKOJ8eyA6VAHE6Na7-jCBktIXd1kB6N5wIPMzY9BJ43WF322Ox79ql4lA3AiGSxFICDIHhqMtpLlVTiwQ%3D%3D)** \-- **but first, let me explain what happened.** Our nightmare started in October of 2020. Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long -- including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he was seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. So Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.When Terence saw Karon illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull him over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs. My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.Then it happened.Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires. Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.**The pressure campaign worked and prosecutors charged my son with ****Second-Degree Murder.****Terence was convicted in December 2022 and he was finally just sentenced -- to 5 1⁄2 years in prison.** Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year!But unless Terence's appeal is successful, he's going to prison -- which is why I'm urgently turning to you for help today.The **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** (LELDF) has stepped forward to pay for Terence's defense and is actively raising funds to pay for the appeal.If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence for over 30 years. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops -- and their families -- at their lowest moments.We expect it will cost at least $150,000 to appeal Terence's conviction.So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone: **[**Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF today?**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=a2a1944b7f2741b5a4e022edbbd2d1e6&_e=uvmziv1Ls6cYVY1pREljV30EevWAABlSWpE3FeIQEL7JWrKPxKSVw29wYFpz6PjLUMQFOJhy5pZEXuFWUtg_lExZKB7D7INEpd3wjbIBKwrjDBnlSG_YG3XGEWI3pYnxKjrHkj1_-2ewoK5ADCs-gtFOCqWcI6iNDH9IA3Lud1uEmePJPK7TxdHrx4Wex8cNKuB48rmiV5FjYDt00p6t8Y4xtiZYNAgoshwxI8ptk6pIG4U6CgN07b7yoTVpjsGNGRDx-etgPlaFmcQyytEGxaoEXt_8SgFjACpZaTXyNWvcJS9RD9BhKjpOf6Q9k8OeNhdSKWKC9yt_zGNiyjyr23rRyEW1RoUEyDDWhHTNae0hFc093db0pk5azfxsJBNlbpB17oMtkkTE0-JHJFg_bQ%3D%3D)**I'm not asking you to donate the entire $150,000 yourself -- though it would be a huge weight off our shoulders if you are able to help that way.**[**But your tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100, or more will help LELDF fully fund Terence's appeal over the next 12 months.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=a2a1944b7f2741b5a4e022edbbd2d1e6&_e=uvmziv1Ls6cYVY1pREljV30EevWAABlSWpE3FeIQEL7JWrKPxKSVw29wYFpz6PjLUMQFOJhy5pZEXuFWUtg_lExZKB7D7INEpd3wjbIBKwrjDBnlSG_YG3XGEWI3pYnxKjrHkj1_-2ewoK5ADCs-gtFOCqWcI6iNDH9IA3Lud1uEmePJPK7TxdHrx4Wex8cNKuB48rmiV5FjYDt00p6t8Y4xtiZYNAgoshwxI8ptk6pIG4U6CgN07b7yoTVpjsGN92n8NUb6CsK6Kh2SzmgPBB54-qGkaRgNxR-7KOhcOxJEFDnFcDADcLid8Z0ic-c9HZQBYun2d6NKwvEDHQv9ihKWt9Doc5rHIyzI8zwKIWV-OXDzndE5m6sAgE_EmKxldlg0r9rVBNQJMl4JKAwl4g%3D%3D)** In addition to Terrence's appeal, LELDF will be funding the defense for three different wrongly accused officers who are set to go to trial within the first three months of the New Year. **[**So if you are at all able, please follow this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=a2a1944b7f2741b5a4e022edbbd2d1e6&_e=uvmziv1Ls6cYVY1pREljV30EevWAABlSWpE3FeIQEL7JWrKPxKSVw29wYFpz6PjLUMQFOJhy5pZEXuFWUtg_lExZKB7D7INEpd3wjbIBKwrjDBnlSG_YG3XGEWI3pYnxKjrHkj1_-2ewoK5ADCs-gtFOCqWcI6iNDH9IA3Lud1uEmePJPK7TxdHrx4Wex8cNKuB48rmiV5FjYDt00p6t8Y4xtiZYNAgoshwxI8ptk6pIG4U6CgN07b7yoTVpjsGNkk1JwyVoPtAy5T0nmZR7kuQYSKwtkgg6TKksmLeNuV0leveRRmaizJw5ROO6OETDqB66Q0779azxuFO5AfzB45wB-uyn4Rq_ItZsH5E5IAuDJOIv16T1opKBSbl1fJlXF0L7FPmRzIbEatjH6cycPA%3D%3D)****Any amount -- $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more -- will help.** And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly since **their crucial end of year goal must be met before January 1st.** Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind folks like you. Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.And thank you in advance for helping LELDF support Terence and other wrongly accused officers.I wish a happy New Year to you and your family and ask that you please pray for mine.
---
Gratefully,
---
Patti Reilly

| Peter,

I can hardly believe how quickly this year flew by. Tomorrow, we’ll be facing our LAST FEC deadline of the year, and we’ll officially be closing the books on 2024.

I always like to look at the bright side:

_**> > Together with BOLD PAC, we elected 7 new Latino progressives across the country. **_The presence of these new leaders has made us stronger and more equipped to deal with the incoming administration.

_**> > This isn’t the first time we’ve dealt with a Trump presidency. **_We’ve taken on Republican majorities before, and this time won’t be the exception.

_**> > We have our work cut out for us. **_Republican majorities on all fronts may have emboldened them, but it has also given us a clear-cut path for how we fight back.

[_**Believe it or not, our team is still busy working, and we’d really appreciate it if you could help us close out the year on a good note. | | Dear Fellow American,

I'm reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar**.

I know, I know. It's a little early to be thinking about 2025. But since you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

**Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before December 31 by clicking on this secure link:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=79251f30f5b94f34aae5ccd113b509e6&_e=iy0bNdE6fNhB3buTJptkB6we2EddXRh6MIqOjrQWVSfZRM87NFwT0V2KbxMYrsHRRLDeMpV5lK38tTTPJMu3lHk4azB7Rme_9d0dXCa79mjgPe6hAVYBjHzMeBGJhrHXj_1DA9YPXP9fZwWlhBfWkuWQN2mTlX3IwlqcJ7oqYTgVLcFQSiVY4XQ4nOPipc-IfTjsQVT81wY_vW8-RNA-DZWPcC1KrpRcDjHxvq1Zyhr8p6i01SuBmDIw8lfz7-P2zJ8AmXJNyqh6KRKEOs5G90f3YbMirIflsuxauUdfXXrkxdFLgR4u9E-1xH5_vQqIbEGUSRqgoyWT83TJNZOsabzv4qy6l9YGoVlATd1tFD4zo4K7ENpA3HaRM0W7HSVDvjswsmV2-5mIn0h1zQWc9A%3D%3D)

As you know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism. You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled by an administrative state that operates without the say of our elected representatives.

It is, therefore, completely **unaccountable** to "we the people."

This collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where you live!

One particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools...

At these schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and actively undermine parents.

In higher education--especially at taxpayer-funded state universities--bloated administrations push ideologies that teach young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting influence. We stay true to our mission...

...to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed, as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

**Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to ...**
* **Teach 4 million Americans in Hillsdale 's _free_ online courses**, including "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The American Left: >From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

* **Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution** to citizens nationwide--especially younger Americans, especially thousands of K-12 students.

* **Provide an American classical education** to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

* **Expand the circulation of _Imprimis_** , Hillsdale's monthly digest of liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

I hope you'll claim your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar** so that when you use it next year, you'll remember how you can advance the important work of defending liberty through education.

Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding--even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to remain INDEPENDENT!

Your generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you, reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You'll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , and restore excellence to K-12 education.

**Please show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $75, or $150 --or the best gift you can--by clicking the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=79251f30f5b94f34aae5ccd113b509e6&_e=iy0bNdE6fNhB3buTJptkB6we2EddXRh6MIqOjrQWVSfZRM87NFwT0V2KbxMYrsHRRLDeMpV5lK38tTTPJMu3lHk4azB7Rme_9d0dXCa79mjgPe6hAVYBjHzMeBGJhrHXj_1DA9YPXP9fZwWlhBfWkuWQN2mTlX3IwlqcJ7oqYTgVLcFQSiVY4XQ4nOPipc-IfTjsQVT81wY_vW8-RNA-DZWPcC1KrpRcDjHxvq1Zyhqge59qBu5CpDuGVlqtri53E0stSna2GrdWvNiwM4n9_LkDpj-X9nh7F0RnPovTCmQxOyY9vwjzdJgzzlheW-46znC5wNXQQ5IVT2HTpEIGO-Dkg8VmIHtRSzNiY-sZvwoyWG8xC0cyiTqLHw410VkVytgDPskxHjpXkQAuaWjbUQ%3D%3D)

And when you do, you'll claim your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar**. But you must act before December 31.

Thank you for being a steadfast Hillsdale supporter. Your generosity is needed now more than ever.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. **Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before December 31 at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=79251f30f5b94f34aae5ccd113b509e6&_e=iy0bNdE6fNhB3buTJptkB6we2EddXRh6MIqOjrQWVSfZRM87NFwT0V2KbxMYrsHRRLDeMpV5lK38tTTPJMu3lHk4azB7Rme_9d0dXCa79mjgPe6hAVYBjHzMeBGJhrHXj_1DA9YPXP9fZwWlhBfWkuWQN2mTlX3IwlqcJ7oqYTgVLcFQSiVY4XQ4nOPipc-IfTjsQVT81wY_vW8-RNA-DZWPcC1KrpRcDjHxvq1Zyhqmj-4qqjm__bRQ9cTAnGQx3sorFWzkF2TDHyqkRxtm4-_BgL9RilGWW9sK6tcAkl_zjewGE5TIXJ27m6KeVit9jF5lM5kieQTo5SUDTbE8ZQObDvxa4CJ1aYlyrQ70rgytYhN-wZPEm4Cl5cvOX8Jxt4z68mp0dlmBG58d02zliA%3D%3D)

When you do, you will defend liberty and help us accomplish our mission year after year. **Everything we accomplish is only possible due to your continued generosity, so thank you for your support of our mission!**

The federal government has become too large and too powerful.

Our federal government's hundreds of federal agencies have grown into a monstrous fourth branch of government that harms our Founding Fathers' vision for our country.

During the first Trump administration, we witnessed leftist bureaucrats sabotaging conservative reforms and pushing radical policies that hurt everyday Americans.

We can't let that happen again.

[**We must dismantle the administrative state now if we want to restore our republic and advance Heritage 's policies that will save the American Dream. **](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c31171a0dd3245599f4e82b899830c70&_e=CKkN1qha6Fi28xLSHwD8gYZHZkinm4R4d3wk8TAuztE2cQbruMugiJo-mFydaisfBgOrLgUHVHrk4G4jCLkf2cW3cRuz1pLXfyY0m5SOeu0oIAaskh5O5FHtNjVZsFGBaDD4dZH9Pd6wQ3fyWcqQC3ejh3QRMYzLOPnoc6FVPSvnvTJpdWJhnVAT1W8rze5iZ_oWznh5hySyH-Q68It-KTNOAaspw4-i0homo_WxOjb_N79aNyGt6p0HlZzv--fLS-bNLYvx29vRsmk8cWErb6FJzleXu70j6T6smvFT3_XT14abS-tzx5v2q2uwn9oOHllUEBnPaIbMCNAVDeTVi3bz2TDniG4bBZ7MppwSPh4%3D)

* Replace Washington's leftist bureaucrats with loyal patriots so they can dismantle the administrative state from within.

* Promote the Good Life for all Americans.

With the second Trump administration starting in a few short weeks, this is our best opportunity to defeat the administrative state once and for all.

Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D.

subject: Thank you.

body:
#
It's Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
Every door knocked, every call dialed, every text sent, every conversation with a neighbor, a friend, a family member—every one of these efforts is a call to action to bring someone new into a movement bigger than all of us, a grassroots movement committed to building a better world.
To every volunteer, supporter, and donor who took on that effort this year, I want to say with a full heart: **thank you**. We could not have gotten this far without you and that's what movement politics is all about.
It's how we build stronger communities and how we beat cynicism and despair with hope and solidarity.
I don't take a single cent from lobbyists.
I don't have call time with billionaires, and I get to campaign independently from revolving door politics because of _you._
I cannot thank each and every one of you enough for refusing to give up.
We have no choice but to win, and our commitment to building a better world will make it so and that's because of you.
Thank you,
Alexandria
Together, we’ve built a movement fighting for transformative change—from Medicare for All to democratizing fundraising power in politics.
We need to show widespread support for Alexandria so she can continue doing what she was elected to do: **demand better.**
[Could you donate $5 today to help us reach our $2.2 million end-of-year fundraising goal so we start off 2025 strong? [ Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/9037a701-69a8-446f-9886-fd53e5a43005?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
NYC is on track **[to double spending](https://substack.com/redirect/e74c8c03-482c-48f9-928f-e561227859ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on housing migrants in 2025, many of whom crossed the U.S. border illegally but are now seeking asylum in accordance with U.S. immigration law.
The area around The Roosevelt Hotel has been the scene of recent violence by suspects tied to the infamous Tren de Aragua gang. NYPD sources say that the gang has rooted itself in the NYC shelter system.
"Once they commit their crimes they go back to the migrant community, where they assimilate themselves with people that are actually here obeying the laws," NYPD Chief of Detectives Joseph Kenny said. "We have 39 members of TDA that have been identified and we have an additional four members that have been identified of a subgroup called Little Devils of 42nd Street. Those are much younger kids."
Migrant crime in the Big Apple is staggering, flooding the city's justice system and comprising nearly **75% of arrests in Midtown Manhattan** , The New York Post **[reported](https://substack.com/redirect/d7f185f5-6c92-4ccb-88d7-6b3ac89b8921?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Most city officials have failed to acknowledge the now-out of control situation.
Southern border state governors largely created the situation out of desperation, frantically and spitefully sending bus-loads of migrants from states like Texas to Democrat-run "sanctuary cities" up north who have never seen the sheer volume and scope of the border crisis.
Now, Democrat mayors like **[Eric Adams are forced to confront the realities](https://substack.com/redirect/bcf51575-06d9-4541-8a09-fb3a54217f2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of open borders and unfettered migration, policies his party has defended tooth and nail, casting accusations of bigotry on any who would suggest the border must be controlled.
"Let me tell you something New Yorkers, never in my life have I had a problem that I did not see an ending to -- I don't see an ending to this," Adams said during a town hall gathering in 2023. **" This issue will destroy New York City."**

body:
What we learned and where we're going in 2025.

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_year_series_state_parti&n=1)
---
Monday, December 30, 2024 | Peter -- An organization is only as strong as its frontline leaders. As a founding co-Chair of the Forward Party and the Chair of our State Party Committee, I get to see firsthand just how strong our Party is. In 2024, the Forward Party put in the hard work of growing our movement with particular investments into local leaders. Building state parties is a challenging undertaking and the rules that govern forming a new party are different in every state, but all states do seem to have one thing in common, no matter which party is in power: The rules are set up to keep more competition out. This sad truth is why the accomplishments of our state parties are so impressive. Over the past several weeks, I’ve been meeting with each of our state leadership teams to hear their successes, challenges, and plans for the future. **What Went Well** Much of our work with state parties in 2024 centered on growing connective tissue between the states and arming state leaders with the resources and tools they will need to continue forging ahead. Forward Party state leaders now regularly join convenings with other state leads around the country almost every week. We launched an expanded curriculum for state leads that we call our “modules” program, covering a range of topics from compliance to communications (and topics that don’t start with “c”). We spent much of the second-half of the year working hand-in-hand with states to build out our candidate endorsement and support programs. As a former candidate, I know how valuable volunteers are, and Forward Party had people on the ground supporting our candidates at a tangible level. It’s a key part of how we had 30 affiliated candidates win office, from local seats to the US Senate. **Lessons Learned** 2024 was not without its challenges. We are a small team and it can be hard to give the time and attention needed to our deserving state-parties, especially because the process for forming new state parties is different in every state. Additionally, we still don’t have sufficient “gathering places” for Forwardists in states that don’t yet have a critical mass of people to form a state party but want to roll up their sleeves to help get there. I look forward to finding a way to engage these individuals personally in 2025. [These are our thoughts from 2024, but we want to hear from you! Please head to this link and fill out your thoughts on lessons learned, the direction the party should head in, and projects we should tackle! We will read them all, and we will highlight our top 10, along with the people who submitted them, in early January as our New Years Resolutions.](https://home.forwardparty.com/2024_end_of_year_feedback?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_year_series_state_parti&n=2) **2025 Projects**
Based on the discussions with the state parties, we have a lot of exciting things in store for 2025, turning challenges into opportunities. In Q1 of next year, we will roll out even more ways for state leads to collaborate with each other, including “working groups” for state leaders who are specializing in functional areas (e.g., comms, fundraising, field). We’ll be introducing better tracking systems to manage our shared work, as well as a “banding” system so that state parties can track their progress against goals, which will help us deploy resources to them more efficiently and responsively. Finally, we’ll keep cranking on building better “containers” for Forwardists who are eager to seed the ground in their states so that they can eventually turn a group of volunteers into a full-fledged party. Bring on 2025! If you're still feeling the season of giving, consider donating to Forward this season! | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate_2024_eoy?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_year_series_state_parti&n=3 "Chip In $25 Today!") Peter, Kevin here, one of the co-founders of Leaders We Deserve.

body:
I’m running for Governor of New Jersey.
Peter, we’ve been through a lot these last couple years. There have been urgent crises in this country, across the world, and here in New Jersey.
As a graduate of the U.S. Naval Academy and a former helicopter aircraft commander, I learned early on that in a crisis, there are only three options: **you can either lead, follow, or get out of the way.**
**[I know which one I pick — and that’s why I’m thrilled to share that I am officially running for Governor of New Jersey. Peter, will you split a contribution between me and Heartland Patriots to become a Founding Donor of my campaign for New Jersey?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/84680?refcode=em20241230-8703&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8703%2E614464%2E5jbZF0)**

In New Jersey, we don’t whine. **We work.**
We’re inventors, innovators, and builders. We work with our minds — and our hands.
So let’s be the state that builds more housing. The state that fixes the economy. And let’s make life more affordable for hard-working New Jerseyans — from health care, to groceries, to child care.
In Congress, I’ve fought every day to address these challenges. They aren’t new, and I’m ready to keep confronting them head-on.
**But we won’t stop there.**
This is the state, more than any other, that guaranteed our freedom as we fought for our nation’s independence. Today, we can also be the state that sets the gold standard for protecting rights and freedoms we know will be under attack from Donald Trump’s Washington – beginning with abortion rights.
Because in New Jersey, we love our country. We’re proud of our state. We value our freedoms. **And we’ll defend them with everything we’ve got.**
In the Navy, I was on a mission to protect our country. Now, I’m announcing my candidacy for governor on a mission to get things done for New Jersey.
**[Peter, I’m asking you to join us. Will you help us make the beginning of our campaign as strong as possible by splitting a contribution of any amount?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/84680?refcode=em20241230-8703&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=8703%2E614464%2E5jbZF0)**

Hi team,
In case you missed it: Michael passed NINE bills in December to support American families and address some of our nation's greatest challenges. Michael passed:
🌲 The Forest Service Flexible Housing Partnerships Act to address the housing crisis in our rural and mountain communities.
🌎 The Good Samaritan Remediation of Abandoned Hardrock Mines Act to help cleanup abandoned mines, which pollute our water and our land.
❤️ The Protecting America’s Children by Strengthening Families Act to support the health and safety of children in foster care.
🥾 The Rural Outdoor Investment Act to help create jobs and boost economies in rural Colorado by funding trails and campgrounds across the country.
💧 The Colorado River Salinity Control Fix Act to improve water quality for communities, businesses and farmers in Colorado and across the Colorado River Basin.

Friends, Today, I join the nation in mourning the loss of former President Jimmy Carter, an exemplary humanitarian, leader, and inspiration to us all. I extend my condolences to President Carter’s family during this difficult time. President Carter was unwavering in his faith, and it was a guiding principle in his service both in and out of the Oval Office. His achievements are as long as the life he lived: from the Camp David Accords and protecting the Alaskan wilderness in Congress to receiving the Nobel Peace Prize and selfless works with Habitat for Humanity. For decades, Jimmy Carter has been an example of true American values and selflessness. We will forever remember him for his good work, kindness, and compassion. Now, it is our job to put into action what we learned from President Carter and continue his mission to treat people with kindness and do good. Sincerely, Rep. Eric Swalwell

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A humble request as we approach the end of the year
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I know we’ve been through a lot together already. I know I’ve asked a lot of you, and I know you can’t donate every time I ask you. I hope you know I don’t expect you to, either.
#

Peter -
I know we’ve been through a lot together already. I know I’ve asked a lot of you, and I know you can’t donate every time I ask you. I hope you know I don’t expect you to, either.
But we do need people to give from time to time — when it’s really important, and when it’s right for them to do so.
Today is one of those times.
We’re about to close out an intense year. We’re approaching our final FEC deadline of 2024, and after it hits we’re legally required to release our numbers and tell everyone — our friends, our foes, and anyone else watching — how much we’ve raised and how many donations we’ve received.
It’s the final, real show of the strength of this campaign.
And as we prepare ourselves for a full term in the United States Senate, with the Republican Party in full control of Congress, and Trump in the White House... It's essential that we show them we’re a force to be reckoned with.
[**So, if you’re still with me, and if you’re ready to enter 2025 ready for anything, please: Make a donation of $5 or anything you can to my campaign.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-dec24.kYyuzx&refcode=em241230-1-90&t=1&akid=3627%2E734936%2E3sMLBL)
